tools.name: accounting_apply_inbound_change
tools.description: Accept an inbound change: one payment the accounting system recorded against documents Trenova sent, shown as Proposed by accounting_list_inbound_changes. Accepting brings it into Trenova on the day it was made, with any credits it used, or marks the settlement it pays as paid, and only while it still matches what is open. The preview shows exactly what would post.

policy.rationale: Posts money in Trenova: a customer payment or a settlement payment, so a person approves each one.

tools.name: accounting_check_connection
tools.description: Check the accounting system connection now and record whether it answers. It renews the authorization if it is about to expire and refreshes the company's details. Use it after a person says they fixed something on the accounting side, or before retrying work that failed because the connection was down. It changes nothing in the books. It cannot reconnect a revoked authorization; a person must do that from the integrations page.

system.description: The accounting system, such as "QuickBooksOnline" or "Xero".

policy.rationale: Asks the accounting system whether it answers and records the result in Trenova; it writes nothing to the books.

tools.name: accounting_check_drift
tools.description: Compare the accounting system with Trenova immediately instead of waiting for the nightly check. It runs in the background and changes nothing on either side; read accounting_list_drift_findings once it has finished.

system.description: The accounting system, such as "QuickBooksOnline" or "Xero".

policy.rationale: Reads every synced document back from the accounting system, which spends the provider's call allowance, so a person approves it.

tools.name: accounting_clear_mapping
tools.description: Remove the accounting system record a Trenova record or setting is mapped to, so it is unmatched again and that record is never proposed for it again. Use it when a person says a mapping is wrong and no right record exists yet; to replace it with another record, use accounting_set_mapping instead.

key.description: The setting's key from accounting_list_mapping_gaps, for the other target types. Examples: "ARAccount", "Freight", "Net30", "ACH".

mappingId.description: The mapping's id from accounting_list_mapping_gaps or accounting_get_mapping. Never guess one.

recordId.description: The Trenova customer, carrier or accessorial charge id, from customer_list, carrier_list or masterdata_list_accessorial_charges.

system.description: The accounting system, such as "QuickBooksOnline" or "Xero".

targetType.description: The kind of Trenova record or setting, when naming it by recordId or key.

policy.rationale: Unmatches a record so it cannot sync until someone maps it again; mapping it again undoes it.

tools.name: accounting_confirm_mapping
tools.description: Confirm Trenova's proposed accounting system matches exactly as accounting_list_mapping_gaps shows them, several at once, so sync can use them. A proposal that changed since it was read is refused; to choose a different record, use accounting_set_mapping.

proposals.description: The proposals to confirm, each as it was shown: the mapping and the record Trenova proposed for it.

externalId.description: The proposed record's externalId, as accounting_list_mapping_gaps shows it under mappedTo.

mappingId.description: The mapping's id, from accounting_list_mapping_gaps or accounting_get_mapping.

policy.rationale: Decides which accounts and records Trenova's documents post to in the books, so a person approves it; clearing or changing a mapping undoes it.

tools.name: accounting_create_reference_record
tools.description: Create an item, customer or vendor in the accounting system and map a Trenova record to it. Use it for an accessorial charge, line type, customer or carrier with no match there, and only when accounting_get_mapping finds no existing record; a duplicate is refused and names the existing one. Accounts, terms and payment methods are the bookkeeper's and are never created.

key.description: The setting's key from accounting_list_mapping_gaps, for the other target types. Examples: "ARAccount", "Freight", "Net30", "ACH".

mappingId.description: The mapping's id from accounting_list_mapping_gaps or accounting_get_mapping. Never guess one.

name.description: The name to create it under. Defaults to the Trenova record's name.

recordId.description: The Trenova customer, carrier or accessorial charge id, from customer_list, carrier_list or masterdata_list_accessorial_charges.

system.description: The accounting system, such as "QuickBooksOnline" or "Xero".

targetType.description: The kind of Trenova record or setting, when naming it by recordId or key.

policy.rationale: Creates a record in the organization's own accounting system; Trenova cannot delete it again, so a person approves it.

tools.name: accounting_dismiss_drift_finding
tools.description: Dismiss an open drift finding, with the reason, keeping both sides as they are. An agent may dismiss only an amount difference within the reconciliation tolerance, which accounting_list_drift_findings marks as withinTolerance. Anything larger, and any deleted, voided or status difference, is a person's decision.

note.description: Why both sides stay as they are, in one sentence a bookkeeper would accept.

policy.rationale: Closes a difference with the books without fixing it, so a person approves it.

tools.name: accounting_get_connection
tools.description: Get whether the accounting system is connected, to which company, and why it last failed. It also says when it last answered, when the authorization must be renewed, whether it was connected by sign-in or with a certificate and when that certificate expires, and whether documents are being sent: sending is NotStarted, Paused, Automatic, or OnRelease when each document waits for a person to release it, with the start date. queue counts how many documents are in each sync status and groups those needing attention by cause. Use it before explaining why something did not reach the books. It returns status and dates, never credentials.

system.description: The accounting system, such as QuickBooksOnline or Xero.

policy.rationale: Reads records the caller may already open; it changes nothing and sends nothing.

tools.name: accounting_get_mapping
tools.description: Get which accounting system record one Trenova record or setting is sent as. Name it by mappingId, or by targetType with recordId for a customer, carrier or accessorial charge, or with key for an account role, line type, term or payment method. With query, options holds up to ten usable accounting records of the right kind whose names match, so you can choose one for accounting_set_mapping.

key.description: The Trenova setting the mapping is for, such as an account role, line type, term or payment method. Its trenovaKey from accounting_list_mapping_gaps, for the other target types. Examples: "ARAccount", "RevenueAccount", "Freight", "Net30", "ACH".

mappingId.description: The accounting mapping's id, from accounting_list_mapping_gaps.

query.description: Words to find in the accounting system's record names, for the records it could be set to.

recordId.description: The Trenova customer, carrier or accessorial charge id, from customer_list, carrier_list or masterdata_list_accessorial_charges. Never guess one.

system.description: The accounting system, such as QuickBooksOnline or Xero.

targetType.description: The kind of Trenova record or setting, when naming it by recordId or key.

policy.rationale: Reads records the caller may already open; it changes nothing and sends nothing.

tools.name: accounting_get_sync_record
tools.description: Get one accounting sync record with its status, why it last failed and every try. It names the document it sends, gives the plain-language resolution, and the accounting system's document number and link once synced. Use it to explain why a document did not reach the books before retrying or skipping it. It never returns what was sent or any credential.

syncRecordId.description: The sync record's id, from accounting_list_sync_records or the run's subject.

policy.rationale: Reads records the caller may already open; it changes nothing and sends nothing.

tools.name: accounting_ignore_inbound_change
tools.description: Dismiss an inbound change, with the reason, so the accounting system's payment is never brought into Trenova. Use it when a person says the payment was already keyed in Trenova, or belongs to something Trenova does not track.

note.description: Why it stays out of Trenova, in one sentence a bookkeeper would accept.

policy.rationale: Keeps a payment the books hold out of Trenova for good, so a person approves it.

tools.name: accounting_list_drift_findings
tools.description: List drift: documents Trenova sent to the accounting system that differ there now, newest first. Each row has both values in minor units, who changed it there, withinTolerance, and an open finding's fixes (directions). Pass an Open row's id to accounting_resolve_drift_finding or accounting_dismiss_drift_finding. Filters: currencyCode, detectedAtFrom/To, differenceMinorMin/Max, externalId, externalUrl, fixObjectType, hasFixObject, hasParty, kind, lastSeenAtFrom/To, objectNumber, objectType, partyName, providerMinorMin/Max, providerModifiedAtFrom/To, providerModifiedBy, providerState, resolution, resolutionNote, resolvedAtFrom/To, status, system, trenovaMinorMin/Max, trenovaState, updatedAtFrom/To.

after.description: The nextCursor of the previous page, with every other argument unchanged; omit for the first page.

currencyCode.description: Only records whose currency code contains this text.

detectedAtFrom.description: Only records whose detected at is on or after this day, in the organization's timezone. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

detectedAtTo.description: Only records whose detected at is on or before this day, in the organization's timezone. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

differenceMinorMax.description: The accounting system's value less Trenova's. Only records whose difference minor is at most this.

differenceMinorMin.description: The accounting system's value less Trenova's. Only records whose difference minor is at least this.

externalId.description: The document's ID in the accounting system. Only records whose external id contains this text.

externalUrl.description: A link to the document in the accounting system. Only records whose external url contains this text.

fixObjectType.description: What the fix made: the record sent, or the memo, void or reversal posted. Only records whose fix object type is one of these.

hasFixObject.description: true for only records that have a fix object, false for only those that have none.

hasParty.description: The customer, carrier or driver on the document. true for only records that have a party, false for only those that have none.

kind.description: Only records whose kind is one of these.

lastSeenAtFrom.description: Only records whose last seen at is on or after this day, in the organization's timezone. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

lastSeenAtTo.description: Only records whose last seen at is on or before this day, in the organization's timezone. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

limit.description: How many rows to return: 25 unless you ask, at most 50.

objectNumber.description: Only records whose object number contains this text.

objectType.description: Only records whose object type is one of these.

partyName.description: Only records whose party name contains this text.

providerMinorMax.description: The accounting system's value, in minor units. Absent when it no longer has the document. Only records whose provider minor is at most this.

providerMinorMin.description: The accounting system's value, in minor units. Absent when it no longer has the document. Only records whose provider minor is at least this.

providerModifiedAtFrom.description: When it was last changed in the accounting system. Only records whose provider modified at is on or after this day, in the organization's timezone. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

providerModifiedAtTo.description: When it was last changed in the accounting system. Only records whose provider modified at is on or before this day, in the organization's timezone. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

providerModifiedBy.description: Who last changed it there, when the accounting system says. Only records whose provider modified by contains this text.

providerState.description: Only records whose provider state contains this text.

query.description: Words to find in the document number, the party name or who changed it.

resolution.description: Only records whose resolution is one of these.

resolutionNote.description: Only records whose resolution note contains this text.

resolvedAtFrom.description: Only records whose resolved at is on or after this day, in the organization's timezone. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

resolvedAtTo.description: Only records whose resolved at is on or before this day, in the organization's timezone. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

sortBy.description: Field to order by. Defaults to most recently created.

sortDirection.description: asc for oldest or smallest first, desc for newest or largest.

status.description: Only records whose status is one of these.

system.description: The accounting system, such as QuickBooksOnline or Xero.

trenovaMinorMax.description: Trenova's value, in minor units. Absent when the difference has no amount. Only records whose trenova minor is at most this.

trenovaMinorMin.description: Trenova's value, in minor units. Absent when the difference has no amount. Only records whose trenova minor is at least this.

trenovaState.description: Only records whose trenova state contains this text.

updatedAtFrom.description: Only records whose updated at is on or after this day, in the organization's timezone. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

updatedAtTo.description: Only records whose updated at is on or before this day, in the organization's timezone. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

policy.rationale: Reads records the caller may already open; it changes nothing and sends nothing.

tools.name: accounting_list_inbound_changes
tools.description: List inbound changes: payments the accounting system recorded against invoices or bills Trenova sent, newest first. Each says what it pays and whether it was brought into Trenova, and if not why (reason), with canApply and canIgnore. Pass a Proposed row's id to accounting_apply_inbound_change or accounting_ignore_inbound_change. Filters: amountMinorMin/Max, currencyCode, decidedAtFrom/To, detectedAtFrom/To, externalId, externalNumber, externalUrl, hasPartyObject, kind, note, partyName, providerModifiedAtFrom/To, providerModifiedBy, reason, resolution, status, system, txnDateFrom/To, updatedAtFrom/To.

after.description: The nextCursor of the previous page, with every other argument unchanged; omit for the first page.

amountMinorMax.description: Only records whose amount minor is at most this.

amountMinorMin.description: Only records whose amount minor is at least this.

currencyCode.description: Only records whose currency code contains this text.

decidedAtFrom.description: Only records whose decided at is on or after this day, in the organization's timezone. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

decidedAtTo.description: Only records whose decided at is on or before this day, in the organization's timezone. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

detectedAtFrom.description: Only records whose detected at is on or after this day, in the organization's timezone. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

detectedAtTo.description: Only records whose detected at is on or before this day, in the organization's timezone. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

externalId.description: The payment's ID in the accounting system. Only records whose external id contains this text.

externalNumber.description: Only records whose external number contains this text.

externalUrl.description: A link to the payment in the accounting system. Only records whose external url contains this text.

hasPartyObject.description: The Trenova customer, carrier or driver it pays for, once matched. true for only records that have a party object, false for only those that have none.

kind.description: Only records whose kind is one of these.

limit.description: How many rows to return: 25 unless you ask, at most 50.

note.description: Only records whose note contains this text.

partyName.description: The customer or vendor as the accounting system names it. Only records whose party name contains this text.

providerModifiedAtFrom.description: When it was last changed in the accounting system. Only records whose provider modified at is on or after this day, in the organization's timezone. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

providerModifiedAtTo.description: When it was last changed in the accounting system. Only records whose provider modified at is on or before this day, in the organization's timezone. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

providerModifiedBy.description: Who last changed it there, when the accounting system says. Only records whose provider modified by contains this text.

query.description: Words to find in the payment's number or the customer or vendor name.

reason.description: Why it was not applied on its own. Absent once applied. Only records whose reason is one of these.

resolution.description: What to do about it, in plain language. Only records whose resolution contains this text.

sortBy.description: Field to order by. Defaults to most recently created.

sortDirection.description: asc for oldest or smallest first, desc for newest or largest.

status.description: Only records whose status is one of these.

system.description: The accounting system, such as QuickBooksOnline or Xero.

txnDateFrom.description: The payment date. Only records whose txn date is on or after this day, in the organization's timezone. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

txnDateTo.description: The payment date. Only records whose txn date is on or before this day, in the organization's timezone. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

updatedAtFrom.description: Only records whose updated at is on or after this day, in the organization's timezone. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

updatedAtTo.description: Only records whose updated at is on or before this day, in the organization's timezone. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

policy.rationale: Reads records the caller may already open; it changes nothing and sends nothing.

tools.name: accounting_list_mapping_gaps
tools.description: List what still has to be matched to the accounting system before anything can sync. It covers account roles, line types, accessorial charges, customers, carriers, terms and payment methods that are unmatched or only proposed; summary says how many required mappings are confirmed and whether setup can finish. Each gap carries its id and the candidates Trenova considered; pass them to accounting_get_mapping or accounting_set_mapping. Filters: requiredOnly, state, system, targetType.

after.description: The nextCursor of the previous page, with every other argument unchanged; omit for the first page.

limit.description: How many rows to return: 25 unless you ask, at most 50.

query.description: Words to find in the Trenova label or the chosen record's name.

requiredOnly.description: true for only the records whose requiredOnly is true, false for only those whose requiredOnly is false. Only the mappings setup cannot finish without.

state.description: Only records whose states is one of these. Unmatched and Proposed unless you name others.

system.description: The accounting system, such as QuickBooksOnline or Xero.

targetType.description: Only records whose target types is one of these.

policy.rationale: Reads records the caller may already open; it changes nothing and sends nothing.

tools.name: accounting_list_sync_records
tools.description: List the documents Trenova sends to the accounting system and where each stands, or say whether particular Trenova documents or parties reached it. List one system's records, newest first, by status (Blocked and DeadLettered did not reach the books), document type or error category. Or pass documentIds of invoices, memos, payments, customers, settlements, carriers or drivers: states holds each one's current record and what that means, across every syncing system unless you name one; a settlement shows its bill or bill payment, whichever needs attention, else the latest, and a document with no state was never sent. A record has its status, error category, resolution, tries and the accounting system's number once synced; pass its id to accounting_get_sync_record for the tries or accounting_retry_sync_record once the cause is fixed. Filters: documentType, errorCategory, status, system.

after.description: The nextCursor of the previous page, with every other argument unchanged; omit for the first page.

documentIds.description: Trenova document ids, or the record on screen, to say whether each reached the accounting system, from invoice_list, invoice_get, receivable_list_customer_payments, settlement_list_carrier or settlement_list_driver. Never guess one. The filters list records instead and are left out with it.

documentType.description: Only records whose object types is one of these.

errorCategory.description: Only records whose error categories is one of these.

limit.description: How many rows to return: 25 unless you ask, at most 50.

query.description: Words to find in Trenova or accounting system document numbers.

status.description: Only records whose statuses is one of these. Blocked and DeadLettered need a person; AwaitingApproval waits to be released.

system.description: The accounting system, such as QuickBooksOnline or Xero. Required to list records; with documentIds, only that system's records answer, and without it every system that syncs does.

policy.rationale: Reads records the caller may already open; it changes nothing and sends nothing.

tools.name: accounting_pause_sync
tools.description: Stop sending documents to the accounting system until someone resumes it. Use it during an accounting system outage, or when a person asks to hold sending, such as while the books are being closed. Nothing is lost: documents keep queueing and go out when accounting_resume_sync runs. Give the reason so others know when to resume.

reason.description: Why sending is paused and what would let it resume, in one sentence.

system.description: The accounting system, such as "QuickBooksOnline" or "Xero".

policy.rationale: Holds what is waiting to go to the books; nothing is sent, changed or lost, and resuming sends it on.

tools.name: accounting_redate_sync_record
tools.description: Send a document the accounting system refused because its date falls in closed books, dated instead on the first open day after the closing date. Use it when the bookkeeper would rather keep the period closed than reopen it. The document keeps its own date in Trenova, and its note in the books names that date. Trenova allows this only when its closed-period posting policy is to post to the next open period; otherwise the period must be reopened in the accounting system and the record retried.

syncRecordId.description: The sync record's id, from accounting_list_sync_records or accounting_get_sync_record. It must be held for a closed period.

policy.rationale: Changes the date the organization's books record for a document, so a person approves it.

tools.name: accounting_refresh_reference_data
tools.description: Read the accounting system's accounts, items, customers, vendors, terms and payment methods again and refresh Trenova's proposals. Use it after a person says they added or renamed something in the accounting system. It runs in the background; check accounting_list_mapping_gaps afterwards. It changes nothing in the books and never touches a confirmed mapping.

system.description: The accounting system, such as "QuickBooksOnline" or "Xero".

policy.rationale: Reads the accounting system and refreshes Trenova's suggestions; it writes nothing to the books and leaves confirmed mappings alone.

tools.name: accounting_reject_mapping
tools.description: Turn down the wrong record Trenova proposed for an accounting mapping, leaving it unmatched. That record is never proposed for it again. Use accounting_set_mapping when the right record is known.

mappingId.description: The mapping's id, from accounting_list_mapping_gaps or accounting_get_mapping. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Unmatches a proposal so it is not used; choosing a record for the mapping undoes it.

tools.name: accounting_release_sync_record
tools.description: Propose releasing documents the organization holds for approval before they go to the accounting system, so they are sent. Name each by its sync record; the person approving may untick some. What is sent cannot be called back, so a person always decides.

syncRecordIds.description: Up to 50 sync records awaiting approval, from accounting_list_sync_records or accounting_get_sync_record.

system.description: The accounting system, such as "QuickBooksOnline" or "Xero".

policy.rationale: Sends documents a review policy held for a person to the organization's books; only a person releases them.

tools.name: accounting_request_backfill
tools.description: Backfill the accounting system with older invoices, memos, payments and settlements. It sends those dated from the start date up to the day sync began, which no live posting sent. Narrow it by from and to dates and documentTypes. Use it only when a person asks for history in the books, and ask whether any of it was already entered there by hand, because those would arrive twice. One backfill runs at a time.

documentTypes.description: Only these kinds of document. Defaults to all of them.

from.description: The first document date to send. Defaults to the start date. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

system.description: The accounting system, such as "QuickBooksOnline" or "Xero".

to.description: The last document date to send. Defaults to the day sending began. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

policy.rationale: Sends historical documents to the organization's books, some of which may already be there by hand, and cannot be called back; a person who manages the integration approves it.

tools.name: accounting_resolve_drift_finding
tools.description: Fix an open drift finding in one direction. PushTrenovaValue sends Trenova's document to the accounting system again: an update, a void, or a new copy of a document deleted there. AdjustTrenova changes Trenova to match the accounting system: a credit or debit memo against the invoice, a void of an invoice gone from it, or the reversal of a payment voided there, none of which is sent back. Only the directions the finding lists under fixes are offered. The preview says exactly what happens.

direction.description: Which side to change: PushTrenovaValue changes the accounting system, AdjustTrenova changes Trenova.

policy.rationale: Changes money on one side of the books: it posts a memo, void or reversal in Trenova, or sends a document to the accounting system, so a person approves each fix.

tools.name: accounting_resume_sync
tools.description: Start sending documents to the accounting system again after it was paused. Everything queued while paused goes out at once, so resume only when a person says the reason for the pause is over, or the outage it was paused for has passed and accounting_get_connection shows the connection answering.

system.description: The accounting system, such as "QuickBooksOnline" or "Xero".

policy.rationale: Releases everything held to the organization's books at once, and a person paused it for a reason, so a person approves it; what is sent cannot be called back.

tools.name: accounting_retry_sync_record
tools.description: Send documents that did not reach the accounting system again. Name the records by syncRecordIds, or retry every record that last failed for the given errorCategories, such as Transient and RateLimited after an outage. Run on its own, the categories are read when it runs; proposed, they become the records they name then, at most 50, which the person approving may untick, and only those are retried. Only Blocked, DeadLettered and Retrying records are retried; a document waiting for a person to release it stays waiting. Retry only once the cause in the record's resolution is fixed or the failure was temporary: a record whose cause still stands is refused again. The accounting system recognizes a repeat, so nothing is entered twice.

errorCategories.description: Retry every retryable record that last failed for one of these reasons.

syncRecordIds.description: Up to 50 sync record ids, from accounting_list_sync_records.

system.description: The accounting system, such as "QuickBooksOnline" or "Xero".

policy.rationale: Sends again, to the organization's own books, documents Trenova already decided to send; the accounting system recognizes a repeat by its request id, so nothing is entered twice, and a document held for release stays held.

tools.name: accounting_set_mapping
tools.description: Choose which accounting system record a Trenova record or setting is sent as, and confirm it. Use an externalId from the mapping's candidates or from the options accounting_get_mapping finds with a query; never guess one. To accept Trenova's proposal, send the proposed record's externalId. Give a short reason a bookkeeper would accept. Only confirmed mappings are used when syncing.

externalId.description: The accounting system record's id, from accounting_get_mapping's candidates or search options.

key.description: The setting's key from accounting_list_mapping_gaps, for the other target types. Examples: "ARAccount", "Freight", "Net30", "ACH".

mappingId.description: The mapping's id from accounting_list_mapping_gaps or accounting_get_mapping. Never guess one.

reason.description: Why this record is the right one, in one sentence.

recordId.description: The Trenova customer, carrier or accessorial charge id, from customer_list, carrier_list or masterdata_list_accessorial_charges.

system.description: The accounting system, such as "QuickBooksOnline" or "Xero".

targetType.description: The kind of Trenova record or setting, when naming it by recordId or key.

policy.rationale: Decides which account or record Trenova's invoices, payments and bills will post to, so a person approves it; clearing or changing it undoes it.

tools.name: accounting_skip_sync_record
tools.description: Mark one document as intentionally not sent to the accounting system, with the reason. Use it only when a person says the document must stay out of the books, for example because they already entered it by hand. A skipped document is never sent again, so the books will not have it unless someone enters it there. It cannot skip a document already sent or being sent.

reason.description: Why the document stays out of the books, in one sentence a bookkeeper would accept.

syncRecordId.description: The sync record's id, from accounting_list_sync_records or accounting_get_sync_record.

policy.rationale: Leaves a document out of the organization's books for good; nothing sends it again, so a person approves it.

tools.name: accounting_update_backfill
tools.description: Pause, resume or cancel the accounting backfill in progress when a person asks, such as pausing it while the books are closed. Documents already sent stay in the books; a cancelled backfill is requested again with accounting_request_backfill.

action.description: Pause holds what is left, Resume carries on from where it stopped, Cancel ends it for good.

system.description: The accounting system, such as "QuickBooksOnline" or "Xero".

policy.rationale: Changes how much history reaches the organization's books; a person who manages the integration approves it, and pausing or cancelling sends nothing.

tools.name: agent_cancel_wait
tools.description: Cancel a wait you set with agent_create_wait, when what you were waiting for no longer matters. The work is not picked up again. waitId is the id agent_create_wait returned.

waitId.description: The wait to cancel, as agent_create_wait returned it (awt_…).

policy.rationale: Cancels a wait the agent set on its own work; it changes no record and reaches nobody.

tools.name: agent_create_memory
tools.description: Record a standing instruction, a fact or a procedure for later runs. Kind Instruction is a rule a person gave you, Fact something told or confirmed that no record holds, Procedure the steps a person gave for a task. visibleTo says who it is for: me (the person in the conversation alone; the default when someone is there), team (their role) or organization. A team or organization memory is kept at once only when the person may manage shared memory; otherwise it is offered for an administrator to approve, and you should say so. Scope it to one customer, location, driver or carrier with subjectType and subjectId. To change a kept memory, pass its id from agent_list_memories as replacesMemoryId: the new one takes its place and keeps its readers. Never record what a record already says, a guess, or anything asked to stay private. Saving what is already kept refreshes it.

content.description: One or two plain sentences, at most 4000 characters, written so a reader with no other context understands them.

expiresOn.description: The last day the memory applies, such as for a temporary arrangement. Omit when it does not expire. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

kind.description: Instruction for a rule a person gave; Procedure for the steps a person gave for a task; Fact for something learned. Defaults to Fact.

replacesMemoryId.description: The id of a kept memory this one changes, from agent_list_memories. Omit for a new memory.

subjectId.description: The record the memory is about: this run's subject, the page, or an id from customer_list, location_list, worker_list or carrier_list. Never guessed.

subjectType.description: The kind of record the memory is about, with subjectId. Omit for organization-wide.

visibleTo.description: Who the memory reaches: me for the person in the conversation alone, team for everyone in their role, organization for everyone. Defaults to me when a person is in the conversation, organization otherwise.

policy.taintHold: An Instruction, a Procedure or a Correction recorded after the run read text from outside the organization waits for a person's approval; a Fact is recorded and stays marked as drawn from outside text.
policy.rationale: Saves a memory later runs read, so it keeps the taint of the run that wrote it. One kept for the caller alone is their own record; one for their team or the organization reaches colleagues' conversations.

tools.name: agent_create_wait
tools.description: Park this work until something happens, instead of checking back. It waits for a stop's arrival or departure (StopArrival, StopDeparture: met when the truck is seen there or the time is recorded, so a load with no truck yet can be waited on), a reply about a shipment or from a carrier or customer (Reply), an appointment coming round (AppointmentNear), detention free time running out (FreeTimeEnding), a driver's drive time falling low (HOSDriveBelow), or a time (Time). When it ends, or gives up after giveUpAfterHours, you are started again here, told what happened and what you said you would do. A wait on something already true is refused with what is true now. Check now what can be checked now, such as a customer's notice preferences, and say what it means before you wait. After setting one, end your turn: say in one line what you are waiting for and what you will do then.

at.description: For Time: when to pick the work up. A local date and time as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM with no UTC offset, such as 2026-10-01T08:00, read in the timezone of where it happens; never Unix seconds.

carrierId.description: For Reply: a reply from this carrier, from carrier_list.

customerId.description: For Reply: a reply from this customer, from customer_list.

description.description: What you are waiting for, in a few words a person reads beside the conversation: "Truck 2214 to reach Kroger DC".

detentionOccurrenceId.description: For FreeTimeEnding: the detention record, from detention_list_occurrences or the run subject (detention.occurrence_opened names it).

driveHoursBelow.description: For HOSDriveBelow: pick the work up once the driver has less than this many hours of drive time left.

giveUpAfterHours.description: How long to wait before giving up and picking the work up anyway. Defaults to 24; at most 168.

minutesBefore.description: For AppointmentNear and FreeTimeEnding: how many minutes before the appointment or the end of free time to pick the work up.

shipmentId.description: For Reply: a reply about this shipment, from shipment_list or the run subject.

shipmentMoveId.description: For StopArrival, StopDeparture and AppointmentNear: the move the stop is on, from shipment_get.

stopId.description: The stop, from shipment_get: required for AppointmentNear; for StopArrival and StopDeparture, leave it out to wait for the move's next one.

then.description: What you will do when it happens, so you pick up where you meant to.

workerId.description: For HOSDriveBelow: the driver, from worker_list.

policy.rationale: Parks the agent's own work until something happens and starts it again then; it changes no record and reaches nobody.

tools.name: agent_find_page
tools.description: Find where something is in Trenova and how to do it there. It returns the page, where it sits in the menu, its link, whether this person may open it, and the steps with the exact labels on screen. Use it for "how do I…", "where is…" and "what is this page for", and whenever the person asks for something you hold no tool for, so you can tell them where they do it themselves. Answer from what it returns; never invent a page, a path, a button or a step.

page.description: Optional: a page's path, to answer from that page's own guide, such as the page the person is on.

question.description: What the person wants to find or do, in their words.

policy.rationale: Searches the product guide for the caller; nothing changes and nothing is sent.

tools.name: agent_get_run
tools.description: Retrieve one agent run by id: which agent ran, what started it, the record it worked on, its status, its summary and, if it failed, why. It can add the writes the run proposed and its last 50 steps. Use agent_list_runs first when you do not have an id.

includeEvents.description: Add the run's last 50 steps: the tools it called, what it refused, when it gave up.

includeProposals.description: Add the writes the run proposed, at most 20, and how each was decided.

runId.description: The agent run's id, from agent_list_runs, a proposal, the page you are on, or a mentioned record.

policy.rationale: Reads a run's own record, whose summary may repeat outside text the run read.

tools.name: agent_guide_profile
tools.description: Correct or add to the profile agents are given about the organization's business or the person's own work, when they say it is wrong or missing something. about organization is the business as a whole: what it runs, for whom, on which lanes, how it is set up ("the Laredo lane is seasonal", "we stopped running reefers"). about me is the person's own work ("I only handle the Midwest accounts", "I'm in billing now"). Write one plain sentence in your own words from what they said; the profile is written again with it. Guidance about the organization is kept at once only when the person may manage agent memory; otherwise it is offered for an administrator to approve, and you should say so. Not for a rule about one customer, record or task, or how to do something: use agent_create_memory for those.

about.description: organization for the business as a whole; me for the person in the conversation's own work.

guidance.description: One plain sentence, at most 500 characters, saying what the profile should take into account, written so a reader with no other context understands it.

policy.taintHold: Guidance recorded after the run read text from outside the organization waits for a person's approval, because every later prompt is written from it.
policy.rationale: Adds a line every later write-up of a profile honours. Guidance about the person's own work reaches only their conversations; guidance about the organization reaches everyone's.

tools.name: agent_list_memories
tools.description: Read what this organization has recorded for its agents: standing instructions, facts agents were told, and corrections people made to earlier proposals. Search by text, or narrow to one customer, location, driver or carrier with subjectType and subjectId, or to one tool. Call this before acting on a customer or a driver you have not been told about in this conversation. To save something, call agent_create_memory directly; it handles a repeat.

id.description: Optional: one memory's id, to read the whole of a memory your instructions show cut short.

kind.description: Optional: Instruction for standing rules to follow, Fact for things agents were told, Correction for fixes people made to earlier proposals, or Procedure for the steps that worked for a task.

limit.description: How many rows to return: 10 unless you ask, at most 50.

query.description: Words to look for in the memory, the name of what it is about, or its tool. Every word need not appear; the closest come first.

subjectId.description: Optional: the record's id, from customer_list, location_list, worker_list or carrier_list to match subjectType, or the page you are on. Give it with subjectType.

subjectType.description: Optional: the kind of record subjectId names. Give both or neither.

toolName.description: Only memories about one tool, such as corrections to dispatch_assign_move.

policy.rationale: Reads memories earlier runs saved, which carry the taint of the run that wrote them. It returns only what the reader's own prompt already reads, so it is used under the assistant like the Desk's memory page.

tools.name: agent_list_runs
tools.description: List agent runs: what each agent did, what started it, the record it worked on, and whether it failed, waits on a decision or is running. agent_get_run reads one. Filters: status (Pending|GatheringContext|Diagnosing|AwaitingDecision|Completed|ShadowCompleted|Failed); trigger (Manual|Chat|Scheduled|Event|Continuous|Wait); subjectType (enum): the kind of record the run worked on, named as agent_get_run reports it (Shipment, BillingQueueItem, AccountingDriftFinding); any other name is refused with the full list; subjectId (text): the id of that record; agentDefinitionId (text): the agent's id, from a run or the page you are on; date: createdAt. Dates: today, nextndays/lastndays with days, or YYYY-MM-DD; never Unix time. Pass mine to keep to this agent's own runs.

filters.description: Conditions, combined with AND. Give value for a single comparison, values for in and notin, days for nextndays and lastndays, and nothing at all for isnull, isnotnull, today, yesterday and tomorrow.

limit.description: How many rows to return: 25 unless you ask, at most 50.

mine.description: Only the calling agent's own runs. On by default when an agent runs on its own and no agent is named, off in a conversation.

offset.description: How many rows to skip. When a result says hasMore, call again with its nextOffset for the next page.

query.description: Optional free text matched across the searchable columns. Omit it when you are filtering on a field.

sortBy.description: Field to order by. Defaults to most recently created.

sortDirection.description: asc for oldest or smallest first, desc for newest or largest.

policy.rationale: Lists agent runs, whose summaries may repeat outside text a run read; a run on a conversation is listed only to the person who owns it.

tools.name: agent_open_page
tools.description: Give the person a link to a page or a record in Trenova, such as the shipments page or one customer, to open if they choose; the app does not move on its own. Use it only when they ask to go to or open a page; to show them a record, fetch it with its get tool instead. Pass a page's path from agent_find_page, or a record's entity and id from the tool that found it; action create opens the page's create form. It refuses a page they may not open.

action.description: Optional: create opens the page's create form.

entity.description: The kind of record to open, with recordId, instead of a page.

page.description: A page's path, exactly as agent_find_page returned it.

recordId.description: The record's id, from the tool that found it (shipment_get, invoice_list and the like) or the record on screen.

policy.rationale: Opens a page in the caller's own browser; nothing changes and nothing is sent.

tools.name: agent_raise_exception
tools.description: Flag a case for a person to review when you cannot resolve it: say what you tried, how severe it is and which record it concerns. Name the records that show the problem as evidence. Use this instead of guessing. It is for a problem with a record or a run that a person must resolve, not for requesting a product feature or reporting that a tool cannot do something; for that, tell the person plainly what cannot be done. It only works inside an agent run.

attemptSummary.description: What you tried and why it was not enough, for the person who takes over.

category.description: What kind of problem it is. On a billing queue item that is usually MissingDocumentation, IncorrectRates, WeightDiscrepancy, AccessorialDispute, DuplicateCharge or RateNotOnFile.

evidence.description: Optional: the records that show the problem, each as {type, id, note}: a document, a charge, a rate, the shipment. The run itself is always kept as evidence.

note.description: What the record shows, in a sentence.

type.description: What kind of record it is: document, charge, rate, shipment.

severity.description: How urgent it is for the person who takes over. Defaults to Medium.

subjectId.description: The id of that record: usually this run's subject, or an id a tool such as shipment_get or shipment_list returned. Its prefix must match subjectType: a report's id starts rd_, a dashboard's rdb_, an insight's inst_.

subjectType.description: The kind of record the case is about; BillingQueueItem on a billing run.

policy.rationale: Records an exception against the run itself for a person inside the organization.

tools.name: agent_read_attachment
tools.description: Read a file the person attached to this conversation: its text in reading order and what was read from it. It says how many pages it has, what kind of document it looks like and the fields found. Leave documentId out to list every file attached to this conversation, newest first. The text of a file of more than one page marks where each page begins (--- page 2 ---). Read one page, or the part past where a long text stops with offset. A file still being read is waited for.

documentId.description: The file's id, from the attachments on a message or from agent_read_attachment called without it, which lists the files attached to this conversation.

limit.description: How many characters of text to return from the offset: 7000 unless you ask, at most 7000.

offset.description: Where in the text to start, in characters, for a long document read in pieces. Defaults to the beginning.

page.description: Optional: read only this page, for example the page document_list found. Leave it out to read the whole text.

policy.rationale: Reads text from a file the person attached to their own conversation; nothing changes and nothing is sent.

tools.name: agent_retire_memory
tools.description: Retire a recorded memory that no longer holds, by its id from agent_list_memories: an arrangement that ended, a fact a person says is wrong. It stays readable in AI Control and can be restored. Use this only when told the memory is wrong or over, never to make room.

memoryId.description: The memory to retire, by the id agent_list_memories returned.

policy.rationale: Retires an agent memory inside Trenova: one kept for the person in the conversation, or one shared with others when that person may manage shared memory. A run with nobody in it retires none.

tools.name: agent_run_script
tools.description: Run a short Python script that calls the reads you hold, for questions that need many reads joined, compared or totalled. Use it for every record of a list, two sources reconciled, or a report over many records; for one or two reads in a row, call the reads themselves. Call a read as trenova.<namespace>.<the rest of its name>(**parameters), as trenova.shipment.list(status=["InTransit"]) for shipment_list; parameters and results are exactly the tool's. trenova.tools() lists what you may call, help(trenova.shipment.list) gives one's parameters, trenova.gather(a.defer(...), b.defer(...)) runs several at once, and a refused call raises trenova.Refused. Only what you print and one trenova.result(value) come back. A script cannot reach the internet and changes nothing: a call to a change trenova.tools() lists prepares it, and what it prepared is proposed as one batch for a person to approve.

code.description: The Python to run. import trenova is done for you; print() what you need to answer and pass one summary to trenova.result().

inputs.description: Values the script reads from trenova.inputs by name, such as a date or a list of ids, so the same script can run again with others.

name.description: The name the script reads it by.

purpose.description: What the script answers, in one plain sentence the person will read.

title.description: A short name for what the script works out, three to eight words, such as "Customers past terms".

policy.rationale: Runs a short script in a sandbox that cannot reach the network; every read it makes is one of the agent's own reads, run as the person under the same checks, and the call carries the taint of every read that brought outside text in. It changes nothing itself: a change it prepares is proposed with the rest of its batch for a person to approve.
Asks the person in the conversation a question; nothing is saved or sent.

tools.name: billing_approve_queue_item
tools.description: Propose approving billing queue items, one or up to 50 in one proposal the person decides together. On your own, propose only items you reviewed and found clean: charges that match the agreement, the documents the customer requires and no detention charge waiting on approval. When the person asks for items, propose those and say in reviewNotes what you could not confirm. Approval creates each item's draft invoice, or puts it on a statement customer's statement, and the auto-post setting may post it; the person may untick items. Name every ready item in one call; an item the queue would refuse is reported, not approved, and the rest still go.

billingQueueItemIds.description: The billing queue items, by id from billing_list_queue_items or billing_get_queue_item. Never guess one.

reviewNotes.description: What you checked, kept on each item as its review notes.

policy.rationale: Approving creates the invoices customers are billed on, so only a person approves, and may untick any of them.

tools.name: billing_assign_biller
tools.description: Assign the biller who reviews billing queue items, one or up to 50 in one call the person decides once. An item waiting for review moves into review with the biller. Leave billerId out to assign the person who asked, which is what "assign me", "start reviewing these" or "get these ready to post" means. Name every item in one call; one the queue would refuse (posted, canceled) is reported and the rest still go.

billerId.description: The biller's user id, when the person named one or the customer's default biller is the assignedBillerId billing_get_queue_item shows on another of its items. Leave it out to assign the person who asked. Never guess one.

billingQueueItemIds.description: The billing queue items, by id from billing_list_queue_items or billing_get_queue_item. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Names who reviews billing queue items inside Trenova; it creates no money and is changed by assigning someone else.

tools.name: billing_cancel_queue_item
tools.description: Propose canceling a billing queue item that should never be billed, such as a duplicate of another item. Canceling drops the charge from billing for good, so a person always decides; say which item it duplicates or why it must not bill.

billingQueueItemId.description: The billing queue item, from billing_list_queue_items, billing_get_queue_item or this run's subject. Never guess one.

reason.description: Why it must not bill, in a short phrase.

policy.rationale: Drops a charge from billing for good, so only a person decides; the agent proposes it.

tools.name: billing_correct_charge_codes
tools.description: Correct or normalize the accessorial charge codes on a billing queue item's charges. Use it when a charge carries the wrong accessorial; the set you send replaces the item's additional charges, so include every charge that should remain, each with an accessorialChargeId from masterdata_list_accessorial_charges. The item must be InReview first (billing_start_review).

additionalCharges.description: The corrected additional charge set to apply to the item.

amount.description: The charge's amount in major units, as a decimal such as 125.00.

id.description: The existing charge this line keeps or corrects, from the item's charges; leave it out for a charge that is new.

method.description: How the amount is applied: Flat once, PerUnit times the unit, Percentage of the linehaul.

unit.description: How many units the charge covers; 1 for a flat charge.

billingQueueItemId.description: The billing queue item whose charges are corrected, from billing_list_queue_items, billing_get_queue_item, this run's subject or the record on the page. Never guess one.

policy.condition: Runs on its own only while nothing has been invoiced from the billing queue item and every charge it adds, removes or changes, counted in full, is within the organization's money limits for agents; any other call waits for a person.
policy.rationale: Rewrites the accessorial charges a customer will be invoiced, so it moves money.

tools.name: billing_get_queue_item
tools.description: Open billing queue items by id: one in full, or up to 50 as a table of what blocks each item's approval and what its shipment still lacks for billing. One item comes with its payer, shipment and the charges this payer is billed, the detention charges holding it, its exception and review notes, and the invoice it made once approved. Its issues are the flagged checks, each with the issueId, whether it is Open or Settled, the options a biller settles it with by optionKey, and whether its settlement can be undone. Read an item before approving, holding, releasing, canceling or sending it back, or settling one of its issues; read the set before assigning, moving into review, approving or posting several. An id that is not a queue item of this organization is named in the note. Amounts are left out, and named in withheldByAccess, when your data access does not reach them.

billingQueueItemIds.description: The items' ids, from billing_list_queue_items, this run's subject, the page you are on. or the proposals that named them.

policy.rationale: Reads records the caller may already open; it changes nothing and sends nothing.

tools.name: billing_hold_queue_item
tools.description: Put a billing queue item on hold, with a note saying what it waits on. Use it when an item waiting for or in review cannot be billed yet but nothing is wrong with it: a document on its way, a customer's confirmation. A held item is taken off hold only when the note's condition is met.

billingQueueItemId.description: The billing queue item, from billing_list_queue_items, billing_get_queue_item or this run's subject. Never guess one.

note.description: What the item waits on, so whoever takes it off hold knows when.

policy.taintHold: Its notes are what a biller or operations reads next, so a run that has read outside text proposes it rather than writing it.
policy.rationale: Parks an item inside Trenova with a note; it creates no money and is undone by moving the item on.

tools.name: billing_list_queue_items
tools.description: List billing queue items, the shipments waiting on a biller. Open one with billing_get_queue_item before deciding it; Posted items need status Posted. Filters: status (ReadyForReview|InReview|OnHold|Exception|SentBackToOps|Approved|Posted|Canceled): ReadyForReview and InReview await a biller; billType (Invoice|CreditMemo|DebitMemo); exceptionReasonCode (MissingDocumentation|IncorrectRates|WeightDiscrepancy|AccessorialDispute|DuplicateCharge|MissingReferenceNumber|CustomerInformationError|ServiceFailure|RateNotOnFile|Other); assignedBillerId (text): a user id; isnull for unassigned; billToCustomerId (text): the payer, from customer_list; id (text): in with several ids reads them together; createdAt (date): when it was queued; text: number, shipment.proNumber; date: reviewStartedAt; number: allocatedTotalAmount. Dates: today, nextndays/lastndays with days, or YYYY-MM-DD; never Unix time.

filters.description: Conditions, combined with AND. Give value for a single comparison, values for in and notin, days for nextndays and lastndays, and nothing at all for isnull, isnotnull, today, yesterday and tomorrow.

limit.description: How many rows to return: 25 unless you ask, at most 50.

offset.description: How many rows to skip. When a result says hasMore, call again with its nextOffset for the next page.

query.description: Optional free text matched across the searchable columns. Omit it when you are filtering on a field.

sortBy.description: Field to order by. Defaults to most recently created.

sortDirection.description: asc for oldest or smallest first, desc for newest or largest.

policy.rationale: Reads records the caller may already open; it changes nothing and sends nothing.

tools.name: billing_list_transfer_candidates
tools.description: List the delivered shipments not yet in the billing queue, oldest first: the same list the transfer-to-billing dialog offers. Each row says what a transfer would do with it (Transfer, MarkReadyAndTransfer, Refused with a failure code, or ReturnToOperations), the documents it still lacks and its rate or validation issues, decided by the checks the transfer itself makes. totals counts and sums the charges of each outcome per currency, so quote them rather than adding rows yourself. A question about what is waiting is answered from this list; propose a transfer only when asked to send them. To transfer, propose one billing_transfer: allTransferable with these same filters when every row that can go should go, or shipmentIds for a hand-picked set, rather than one call per shipment.

customerId.description: Only this customer's shipments, by id from customer_list.

deliveredFrom.description: Only shipments delivered on or after this day. A date as YYYY-MM-DD, or today.

deliveredTo.description: Only shipments delivered on or before this day. A date as YYYY-MM-DD, or today.

limit.description: How many rows to return: 25 unless you ask, at most 50.

markCompletedReadyToInvoice.description: Decide as a transfer that first marks completed shipments ready to invoice would. Defaults to false.

offset.description: How many rows to skip. When a result says hasMore, call again with its nextOffset for the next page.

query.description: Words matched against pro number, BOL and the other searchable columns, as the dialog's search box does.

status.description: Only shipments in this status. Completed shipments transfer only when markCompletedReadyToInvoice is true.

policy.rationale: Reads records the caller may already open; it changes nothing and sends nothing.

tools.name: billing_manage_transfer_run
tools.description: Stop a background transfer to billing that is still running, or Retry the shipments a finished one could not transfer. Take the run id from billing_transfer's result. Only the person who started a transfer can stop it; shipments already transferred stay in the queue.

action.description: Stop a running transfer, or Retry a finished one.

billingTransferRunId.description: The billing transfer run, from billing_transfer's result. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Stops or reruns a transfer inside Trenova; nothing is invoiced or sent, and a stopped run is retried the same way.

tools.name: billing_raise_exception
tools.description: Move a billing queue item in review into exception for a biller to resolve. Use it when the bill itself is wrong: a rate that disagrees with the agreement, a disputed accessorial, a duplicate charge. Give the reason and notes that say what is wrong and what would clear it.

billingQueueItemId.description: The billing queue item, from billing_list_queue_items, billing_get_queue_item or this run's subject. Never guess one.

exceptionReasonCode.description: What is wrong with the bill.

note.description: What is wrong and what would clear it, with the figures you checked.

policy.taintHold: Its notes are what a biller or operations reads next, so a run that has read outside text proposes it rather than writing it.
policy.rationale: Marks an item for a biller to resolve inside Trenova; it creates no money and a biller moves it back when it is resolved.

tools.name: billing_reassign_charge
tools.description: Move who pays one charge on a shipment in billing review: its freight or one accessorial, whole to another payer or split among several. A payer who gains a share gets a queue item and one left with nothing has theirs canceled. An empty allocations list gives the charge back to the shipment's own payer. Only while every queue item for the shipment is in review or on hold.

additionalChargeId.description: The accessorial charge, from the shipment's charges billing_get_queue_item lists. Needed for Accessorial.

amount.description: The share as an amount such as 250.00, when method is Amount.

billToCustomerId.description: The customer who pays this share, from customer_list. Never guess one.

method.description: Whether the share is a percent of the charge or a fixed amount.

percent.description: The share as a percent such as 60, when method is Percent.

chargeKind.description: Which charge: the freight, or one accessorial.

itemId.description: The billing queue item, from billing_list_queue_items or billing_get_queue_item. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Moves what each customer is billed for a shipment and opens or cancels their queue items; only a person reassigns a charge.

tools.name: billing_release_queue_item
tools.description: Take a billing queue item off hold and back to the status the hold found it in, the counterpart of billing_hold_queue_item. A hold was put on for a reason: read the item's review notes with billing_get_queue_item and release it only when the record shows that what it waited on has arrived, never because nothing looks wrong.

billingQueueItemId.description: The billing queue item, from billing_list_queue_items, billing_get_queue_item or this run's subject. Never guess one.

policy.taintHold: What the hold waited on is what outside text would claim has arrived, so a run that has read it proposes the release rather than making it.
policy.rationale: Moves an item back into the review queue inside Trenova; it creates no money and billing_hold_queue_item puts it back on hold.

tools.name: billing_resolve_issue
tools.description: Propose settling one of a billing queue item's flagged checks with one of the choices that check offers. A choice bills a charge as it stands, takes it off, reprices it, bills without the paperwork, or asks the driver for a signed POD. billing_get_queue_item lists each check's issueId and its options with their optionKey; use them exactly. Settling can change what the customer is charged, so a person always decides, and asking the driver settles nothing until the paperwork arrives.

billingQueueItemId.description: The billing queue item, from billing_list_queue_items, billing_get_queue_item or this run's subject. Never guess one.

issueId.description: The check, by the id billing_get_queue_item lists under the item's issues. Never guess one.

optionKey.description: The optionKey of the choice, exactly as billing_get_queue_item lists it under the check.

policy.rationale: Decides what a customer is billed for a flagged charge, or messages the driver for paperwork, so only a person settles it; billing_undo_issue takes it back.

tools.name: billing_return_to_operations
tools.description: Send a billing queue item in review back to operations to fix, with a reason. Use it when the fix belongs to the shipment rather than the bill: a missing document operations must collect, a wrong weight, a missing reference number. Operations sees a high-priority note on the shipment saying why. Read the item with billing_get_queue_item first. Notes are required when the reason is Other.

billingQueueItemId.description: The billing queue item, from billing_list_queue_items, billing_get_queue_item or this run's subject. Never guess one.

note.description: What operations has to fix, in a sentence they can act on. Required when the reason is Other.

policy.taintHold: Its notes are what a biller or operations reads next, so a run that has read outside text proposes it rather than writing it.
policy.rationale: Returns an item to operations with a note on its shipment inside Trenova; it creates no money and the item comes back when operations fixes it.

tools.name: billing_start_review
tools.description: Move billing queue items into review, one or up to 50 in one call the person decides once. An item with no biller is assigned the person who asked, or the billerId you name. Name every item that needs a biller's attention in one call; one the queue would refuse is reported and the rest still go.

billerId.description: The biller's user id, when the person named one or the customer's default biller is the assignedBillerId billing_get_queue_item shows on another of its items. Leave it out to assign the person who asked. Never guess one.

billingQueueItemIds.description: The billing queue items, by id from billing_list_queue_items or billing_get_queue_item. Never guess one.

policy.condition: An item on hold was held there by a person or a rule, so moving one into review is a proposal a person decides; an item in any other state moves as far as the agent allows, and one that cannot be read waits for a person. A set is held to what its most guarded item allows.
policy.rationale: Moves billing queue items into review inside Trenova; nothing is sent anywhere.

tools.name: billing_transfer
tools.description: Transfer delivered shipments to the billing queue, as the transfer-to-billing dialog does: each becomes a queue item a biller reviews. When the person means every shipment that can go (all of them, everything ready), set allTransferable to true, with the same filters billing_list_transfer_candidates takes, instead of copying ids: the proposal lists each shipment it resolves to. For a hand-picked set, give shipmentIds from billing_list_transfer_candidates. Cover every shipment in one call rather than one call per shipment; a shipment the checks refuse is reported, not transferred, and the rest still go. The person approving may untick shipments. Up to 100 transfer at once; more run as a background transfer.

allTransferable.description: True to transfer every shipment billing_list_transfer_candidates says would transfer, narrowed by query, status, customerId, deliveredFrom and deliveredTo. Use it instead of shipmentIds, never with them; leave it out when naming shipmentIds, whose filters are then ignored.

billType.description: What the queue items bill. Defaults to Invoice.

customerId.description: Only this customer's shipments, by id from customer_list.

deliveredFrom.description: Only shipments delivered on or after this day. A date as YYYY-MM-DD, or today.

deliveredTo.description: Only shipments delivered on or before this day. A date as YYYY-MM-DD, or today.

markCompletedReadyToInvoice.description: Mark Completed shipments ready to invoice first, as the dialog can. Defaults to false, which leaves a Completed shipment where it is.

query.description: Words matched against pro number, BOL and the other searchable columns, as the dialog's search box does.

shipmentIds.description: The shipments to transfer, by id from billing_list_transfer_candidates, when not allTransferable. Never guess one.

status.description: Only shipments in this status. Completed shipments transfer only when markCompletedReadyToInvoice is true.

policy.rationale: Hands delivered shipments to the billing queue inside Trenova, by the checks the transfer dialog makes; a biller, or the organization's own auto-approve rule, still decides every item.

tools.name: billing_undo_issue
tools.description: Propose taking back how one of a billing queue item's checks was settled. The check is open again and any charge the settlement removed or repriced is put back as it was. billing_get_queue_item lists each check's issueId and whether its settlement can be undone; only a settled check on an item still in review can be. It can change what the customer is charged, so a person always decides.

billingQueueItemId.description: The billing queue item, from billing_list_queue_items, billing_get_queue_item or this run's subject. Never guess one.

issueId.description: The check, by the id billing_get_queue_item lists under the item's issues. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Puts back a charge a settlement removed or repriced, which changes what the customer is billed, so only a person decides.

tools.name: carrier_accept_invoice_match
tools.description: Propose accepting a carrier's invoice that matches what the load was expected to cost, clearing it for payment on the carrier's settlement. A person always decides. An invoice with a variance needs carrier_accept_invoice_match_with_variance or a rejection instead.

matchId.description: The carrier invoice match, from carrier_list_invoice_matches. Never guess one.

note.description: Anything accounts payable should know about the acceptance.

policy.rationale: Clears a carrier's invoice for payment; only a person approves what the organization pays.

tools.name: carrier_accept_invoice_match_with_variance
tools.description: Propose accepting a carrier's invoice that differs from the expected cost and paying the difference. The variance is accrued as an adjustment on the carrier's next settlement. A person always decides; say why the variance is owed, such as agreed detention.

matchId.description: The carrier invoice match, from carrier_list_invoice_matches. Never guess one.

note.description: Why the variance is owed.

policy.rationale: Agrees to pay a carrier more or less than the load was expected to cost; only a person approves it.

tools.name: carrier_acknowledge_intelligence_event
tools.description: Mark a carrier finding as seen when it does not bear on whether the carrier can be given freight. Use it for a new address, a changed contact, a score that moved within its band. A finding that does bear on eligibility is not acknowledged: it is acted on, then closed with carrier_resolve_intelligence_event.

eventId.description: The finding id, from carrier_list_intelligence_events, carrier_get_intelligence_event or this run's subject. Never guess one.

note.description: Why you are acknowledging it, for the carrier's record.

resolution.description: What came of the finding. Only used when closing one.

policy.rationale: Acknowledges a carrier finding inside Trenova.

tools.name: carrier_apply_intelligence_suggestions
tools.description: Correct a carrier's profile where its intelligence result disagrees: name, DBA, MC number, safety rating, address, phone, email or insurance. Name the fields and policies to apply, or leave both out to apply every suggestion there is now.

carrierId.description: The carrier, from carrier_list or carrier_get. Never guess one.

policyIds.description: The insurance policies to correct, by the policy id on the page you are on.

policy.rationale: Edits the carrier's own profile inside Trenova from what the provider reports; nothing is sent, and the old values are set back by hand.

tools.name: carrier_create
tools.description: Add a carrier the organization can tender freight to: its code, name, USDOT and MC numbers, SCAC, address and dispatch contact. Check carrier_list first. Vetting and compliance are carrier_vet's; payment and remit-to details are only proposed.

carrierType.description: What kind of carrier it is. Defaults to Common.

code.description: The carrier's short code, unique in this organization.

dbaName.description: The name it does business as, when that differs.

is1099Eligible.description: Whether payments are reported on a 1099.

mcNumber.description: The MC docket number, digits only.

name.description: The carrier's legal name.

note.description: Anything colleagues booking this carrier should know.

paymentMethod.description: How the carrier is paid. Defaults to Check. Payment details are only ever proposed and change on a person's approval.

paymentTermDays.description: Days after the invoice the carrier is paid. Defaults to 30.

remitState.description: The remit-to state. The two-letter US state abbreviation, such as TX.

remitToName.description: Who payment is made out to.

scac.description: The two to four letter SCAC.

state.description: The state of the street address. The two-letter US state abbreviation, such as TX.

taxId.description: The tax id payments are reported under.

taxIdType.description: Whether the tax id is an EIN or an SSN; required with a tax id.

w9OnFile.description: Whether a signed W-9 is on file.

policy.taintHold: A record read from a document or message someone outside sent is proposed, since colleagues book and pay against it.
policy.rationale: Adds a carrier inside Trenova that colleagues can then book; nothing is sent. Payment and remit-to details decide where money goes, so a call that sets them is money and runs only on a person's approval.

tools.name: carrier_create_capacity_posting
tools.description: Record trucks a carrier says it has available: where they are, when, how many, the equipment and the rate it asked. Coverage suggestions and the capacity strip offer these trucks against uncovered loads.

availableFrom.description: When the trucks are free. A date and time with its UTC offset (RFC 3339), such as 2026-10-01T08:00:00-05:00.

availableTo.description: When the offer ends, at most 60 days after it starts. A date and time with its UTC offset (RFC 3339), such as 2026-10-01T08:00:00-05:00.

carrierId.description: The carrier offering the trucks, from carrier_list.

destinationState.description: Where the carrier wants to go, when it said. The two-letter US state abbreviation, such as TX.

equipmentTypeId.description: The trailer type offered, from equipment_list_types.

note.description: Anything else the carrier said.

originLocationId.description: Where the trucks are, from location_list. Give this, originState, or both.

originRadiusMiles.description: How many miles from the origin location the carrier will pick up; only with an origin location.

originState.description: The state the trucks are in, when no location is named. The two-letter US state abbreviation, such as TX.

rate.description: The rate the carrier asked. A decimal such as 2.35.

rateMethod.description: Whether the rate is per loaded mile or for the whole move.

policy.taintHold: A record read from a document or message someone outside sent is proposed, since colleagues book and pay against it.
policy.rationale: Adds a capacity posting inside Trenova; nothing is sent to the carrier, and carrier_delete_capacity_posting removes it.

tools.name: carrier_create_invoice_match
tools.description: Match a carrier's EDI invoice to the load it bills, comparing its total with what the carrier assignment was expected to cost. The match is Matched when within tolerance and Variance when not. Link the invoice to a carrier first with edi_link_carrier_invoice when it has none.

ediCarrierInvoiceId.description: The EDI carrier invoice, from edi_list_carrier_invoices. Never guess one.

proNumber.description: The pro number it bills, when the invoice carries none.

shipmentId.description: The shipment it bills, from shipment_list, when the invoice's own references do not find it.

policy.rationale: Records how a carrier's invoice compares with the expected cost inside Trenova; nothing is paid until a person accepts it.

tools.name: carrier_delete_capacity_posting
tools.description: Remove a carrier capacity posting the carrier withdrew or that was entered by mistake.

carrierCapacityPostingId.description: The posting to remove, from carrier_list_capacity_postings. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Removes trucks a carrier offered from Trenova; nothing is sent, and carrier_create_capacity_posting records them again.

tools.name: carrier_get
tools.description: Retrieve one carrier by id, including its authority, insurance and compliance state. Use carrier_list first when you have a name or a code.

policy.rationale: Reads records the caller may already open; it changes nothing and sends nothing.

tools.name: carrier_get_intelligence_event
tools.description: Retrieve one carrier intelligence event by id: what changed on the carrier's authority, insurance or safety record, and its severity. It also gives the prior and current values and whether anyone has acknowledged or resolved it. Use carrier_list_intelligence_events first when you do not have an id, and carrier_get for the carrier itself.

eventId.description: The carrier intelligence event's id, from carrier_list_intelligence_events, the page you are on, this run's subject or a mentioned record.

policy.rationale: Reads records the caller may already open; it changes nothing and sends nothing.

tools.name: carrier_import
tools.description: Add a carrier found through carrier sourcing to the organization's carriers by its DOT number, filled from the provider's profile. A DOT number already on a carrier is refused.

code.description: The short code to file it under. Left out, one is made from its name.

dotNumber.description: The carrier's USDOT number, from the sourcing search.

enrollMonitoring.description: Start monitoring it at once. Monitoring is billed per carrier.

policy.rationale: Creates a carrier inside Trenova from the provider's profile; nothing is sent to it, and one added in error is made inactive.

tools.name: carrier_list
tools.description: List the carriers this organization tenders freight to, narrowed by status, compliance, safety rating or authority number. Use it before tendering a load to check a carrier is qualified.
