policy.rationale: Returns a settlement to draft with a note inside Trenova; nothing is paid and it is submitted again once fixed.

tools.name: settlement_reject_driver
tools.description: Send a driver settlement that is pending approval back to draft, with the reason. Use it when a line, a rate or a deduction is wrong and someone must fix it before it is approved; the reason is added to its notes.

reason.description: What is wrong and what would fix it, in a sentence payroll can act on.

settlementId.description: The driver settlement, from settlement_list_driver or settlement_get_driver or this run's subject. Never guess one. settlement_list_driver finds it by the driver's name as query, with no lookup before it.

policy.taintHold: Its text is what payroll or the payee reads next, so a run that has read outside text proposes it rather than writing it.
policy.rationale: Returns a settlement to draft with a note inside Trenova; nothing is paid and it is submitted again once fixed.

tools.name: settlement_release_pay_event
tools.description: Release a held driver pay event back into the pool the next settlement draws from. Where the settlement control attaches accruals to open drafts, it joins the driver's open draft at once. Release only once what the hold waited on is resolved.

payEventId.description: The pay event, from settlement_list_pay_events or the lines settlement_get_driver lists. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Returns held pay to the settlement pool inside Trenova; nothing is paid until a settlement is approved, and the pay is held again the same way.

tools.name: settlement_remove_carrier_adjustment
tools.description: Remove a manual adjustment line from a draft or pending carrier settlement. Only a line someone added by hand can be removed; earnings and deductions computed from pay records are corrected at their source and recalculated.

lineId.description: The adjustment line's id, from the lines settlement_get_carrier lists. Never guess one.

settlementId.description: The carrier settlement, from settlement_list_carrier or settlement_get_carrier or this run's subject. Never guess one.

policy.condition: Runs on its own only when an agent added the line, the settlement is not yet approved and the line is within the organization's money limits for agents; any other call waits for a person.
policy.rationale: Changes what the carrier will be paid on a settlement a person still approves, so it moves money; the line is added back the same way.

tools.name: settlement_remove_driver_adjustment
tools.description: Remove a manual adjustment line from a draft or pending driver settlement. Only a line someone added by hand can be removed; earnings and deductions computed from pay records are corrected at their source and recalculated.

lineId.description: The adjustment line's id, from the lines settlement_get_driver lists. Never guess one.

settlementId.description: The driver settlement, from settlement_list_driver or settlement_get_driver or this run's subject. Never guess one. settlement_list_driver finds it by the driver's name as query, with no lookup before it.

policy.condition: Runs on its own only when an agent added the line, the settlement is not yet approved and the line is within the organization's money limits for agents; any other call waits for a person.
policy.rationale: Changes what the driver will be paid on a settlement a person still approves, so it moves money; the line is added back the same way.

tools.name: settlement_resolve_dispute
tools.description: Draft the decision on a driver's pay dispute for a person to approve. Approve or deny it with a resolution note the driver reads, and for an approval, an optional adjustment that pays the driver back on their open draft settlement, or on a new off-cycle one when they have none. A denial carries no adjustment.

adjustmentAmount.description: For an approval, what to pay back as a decimal such as 42.50; negative to take money back. Leave it out for none.

adjustmentDescription.description: What the adjustment is for, as the driver and payroll read it. Required with an adjustment.

decision.description: Approve to side with the driver, Deny to turn the dispute down.

disputeId.description: The pay dispute, from settlement_get_driver's openDisputes, settlement_get_dispute or the page you are on. Never guess one.

payCodeId.description: The pay code the adjustment posts under, from settlement_list_pay_codes. Leave it out for the default account.

resolutionNote.description: The decision in words the driver reads in Dash. Required either way.

policy.rationale: Decides a driver's pay complaint, tells the driver, and can add pay to a settlement, so a person approves it and it runs as them; a decided dispute stays decided.

tools.name: settlement_review_driver_expense
tools.description: Draft the decision on a driver's expense claim for a person to approve. Approve it to reimburse it on the driver's open draft settlement, or a new off-cycle one, or reject it with a note saying why. An organization that requires receipts refuses an approval without one.

decision.description: Approve to reimburse it, Reject to turn it down.

expenseId.description: The expense, from settlement_list_driver_expenses or the page you are on. Never guess one.

note.description: What the driver reads with the decision. Required to reject.

policy.rationale: Pays or refuses a driver's out-of-pocket expense and tells the driver, so a person approves it and it runs as them; a reviewed expense stays reviewed.

tools.name: settlement_start_dispute_review
tools.description: Move an open pay dispute a driver raised to under review, so the driver and the team see someone is looking into it. It decides nothing; settlement_resolve_dispute does.

disputeId.description: The pay dispute, from settlement_get_driver's openDisputes, settlement_get_dispute or the page you are on. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Marks the dispute as being worked inside Trenova; the driver sees its status in Dash, and resolving it moves it on.

tools.name: settlement_submit_carrier
tools.description: Submit a draft carrier settlement for approval once its lines are right. It moves to pending approval, where a person approves it or sends it back. Read it with settlement_get_carrier first; one with exceptions should be fixed or explained before it goes.

settlementId.description: The carrier settlement, from settlement_list_carrier or settlement_get_carrier or this run's subject. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Moves a draft into the approval queue inside Trenova; nothing is paid and a reviewer sends it back to draft.

tools.name: settlement_submit_driver
tools.description: Submit a draft driver settlement for approval once its lines are right. It moves to pending approval, where a person approves it or sends it back. Read it with settlement_get_driver first; one with exceptions should be fixed or explained before it goes.

settlementId.description: The driver settlement, from settlement_list_driver or settlement_get_driver or this run's subject. Never guess one. settlement_list_driver finds it by the driver's name as query, with no lookup before it.

policy.rationale: Moves a draft into the approval queue inside Trenova; nothing is paid and a reviewer sends it back to draft.

tools.name: settlement_update_escrow_account
tools.description: Propose changing an escrow account's target balance or the interest it earns, as an amended lease sets them. The balance itself changes only through contributions and settlement_adjust_escrow_account. A person always decides.

accountId.description: The escrow account, from settlement_list_escrow_accounts. Never guess one.

annualInterestRate.description: The annual interest rate paid on the balance, as a percent such as 2.5.

targetAmount.description: The new target balance, as a decimal.

policy.rationale: Changes the escrow terms of an owner-operator's lease; only a person agrees them.

tools.name: settlement_update_recurring_deduction
tools.description: Propose changing a driver's recurring deduction: its amount, cap, schedule, dates or description, or pausing, resuming or completing it. What was already taken or paid stays as it is. Only the values you give change. A person always decides.

amount.description: The amount each time, as a decimal such as 25.00.

deductionId.description: The recurring deduction, from settlement_list_recurring_deductions. Never guess one.

description.description: What it is for, as it will read on the driver's statement.

endDate.description: The last day it applies, when it ends. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

payCodeId.description: The deduction pay code it posts under, from settlement_list_pay_codes.

startDate.description: The first day it applies. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

status.description: Paused stops it for now; Completed ends it for good.

totalCap.description: The total after which it stops, when there is one.

policy.rationale: Changes money taken from or added to a driver's pay every settlement; only a person agrees it.

tools.name: settlement_update_recurring_earning
tools.description: Propose changing a driver's recurring earning: its amount, cap, schedule, dates or description, or pausing, resuming or completing it. What was already taken or paid stays as it is. Only the values you give change. A person always decides.

amount.description: The amount each time, as a decimal such as 25.00.

description.description: What it is for, as it will read on the driver's statement.

earningId.description: The recurring earning, from settlement_list_recurring_earnings. Never guess one.

endDate.description: The last day it applies, when it ends. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

payCodeId.description: The earning pay code it posts under, from settlement_list_pay_codes.

startDate.description: The first day it applies. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

status.description: Paused stops it for now; Completed ends it for good.

totalCap.description: The total after which it stops, when there is one.

policy.rationale: Changes money taken from or added to a driver's pay every settlement; only a person agrees it.

tools.name: settlement_void_carrier
tools.description: Propose voiding a carrier settlement that is not yet paid, with the reason. A posted one has its journal entry reversed. Its pay returns to the pool to be settled again, so a person always decides.

reason.description: Why it must not be paid, such as a duplicate of another settlement.

settlementId.description: The carrier settlement, from settlement_list_carrier or settlement_get_carrier or this run's subject. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Cancels a settlement for good and reverses any posting; only a person voids.

tools.name: settlement_void_driver
tools.description: Propose voiding a driver settlement that is not yet paid, with the reason. A posted one has its journal entry reversed. Its pay returns to the pool to be settled again, so a person always decides.

reason.description: Why it must not be paid, such as a duplicate of another settlement.

settlementId.description: The driver settlement, from settlement_list_driver or settlement_get_driver or this run's subject. Never guess one. settlement_list_driver finds it by the driver's name as query, with no lookup before it.

policy.rationale: Cancels a settlement for good and reverses any posting; only a person voids.

tools.name: settlement_void_payroll_export
tools.description: Draft voiding a payroll run for a person to approve, with the reason: the run is taken back and every week in it returns to approved, ready for another run. A run already voided is refused.

payrollExportId.description: The payroll run, from settlement_list_payroll_exports. Never guess one.

reason.description: Why the run is voided, kept on it.

policy.rationale: Takes back a payroll run that payroll may already have paid from, so a person approves it and it runs as them; a voided run stays voided.

tools.name: shipment_add_charge
tools.description: Add an accessorial charge to a saved shipment not yet invoiced, at the charge's own rate unless you give an amount. It takes a lumper, layover, tarp, extra stop or any charge from masterdata_list_accessorial_charges. An invoiced shipment is corrected with a credit memo.

accessorialChargeId.description: The charge, from masterdata_list_accessorial_charges. Not detention: a detention charge is approved with detention_approve.

amount.description: The rate per unit, or the flat amount, as a decimal such as 150.00, when the person named one; leave it out to use the charge's configured rate.

shipmentId.description: The shipment to charge, from shipment_list.

units.description: How many units: hours, stops, days or pieces for a per-unit charge. 1 for a flat charge. Defaults to 1.

policy.rationale: Adds to what the customer is billed for the shipment.

tools.name: shipment_add_comment
tools.description: Leave a note on a shipment's comment thread, where dispatch will read it. Use it to record what you found or what you did — a carrier's confirmation, a discrepancy, why something was held. The note is internal unless you say otherwise, and is marked as written by the assistant.

comment.description: What to say, in the words a dispatcher would use.

priority.description: How urgently dispatch should read it. Defaults to Normal; use High or Urgent only for something that changes what happens to the load today.

shipmentId.description: The shipment to comment on, from the page, shipment_list or shipment_list.

visibility.description: Who sees it. Defaults to Internal; only widen it when the person asked for the note to reach a customer or a driver.

policy.rationale: An internal note stays inside the organization; a customer or driver note is read outside it, so its visibility argument decides. A note written on its own after the run read outside text is marked as drawn from it.

tools.name: shipment_attach_document
tools.description: Attach a document that already exists to a shipment, so it rides with the load and its billing. Use it for a POD, a rate confirmation or a signed bill that arrived on its own and belongs to a shipment you have identified. Find the document first — document_get_summary and the document searches return its id. This moves an existing file; it cannot upload one, so a document that is not in the system yet has to be uploaded by a person before it can be attached.

documentId.description: The document to attach, from document_get_summary or a search.

shipmentId.description: The shipment it belongs to, from the page, shipment_list or shipment_list.

policy.rationale: Files a document already in Trenova against a shipment; nobody outside is told.

tools.name: shipment_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a shipment the person says is off. It releases its assignments, withdraws live tenders, sends the reason to a linked trading partner over EDI and stops it being billed. shipment_uncancel reopens it if the freight comes back. Never cancel a record that merely looks wrong; correct it.

reason.description: Why it is being cancelled, in the customer's or dispatcher's own terms. This is kept on the record.

shipmentId.description: The shipment to cancel, from the page, shipment_list.

policy.rationale: Cancelling withdraws live tenders from carriers and sends the model's cancel reason to a linked partner over EDI.

tools.name: shipment_create
tools.description: Enter a new shipment, priced by the customer's rate agreement when no price is given; to copy one, use shipment_duplicate. Match its customer, stops and commodities first with one shipment_match_records call, and propose what it says is missing instead of stopping. Do not interview the person first: fill what the conversation, page and lookups give and call it; ask_user only for what it refuses as missing. Price it the way the person did: "$2,450 flat" is the Flat Rate template, "$2.10 a mile" Per Mile, and charges they name are accessorial charges. Given no price, leave the rating out: it finds the agreement itself; ask for one only when none covers the lane. Add the freight and one move with its stops in travel order, each with a location and a local window; a window that has passed is entered as written. The system assigns the pro number; the BOL is optional, and a BOL must be unique.

additionalCharges.description: Accessorial charges agreed for the shipment.

amount.description: The charge's amount in major units, as a decimal such as 125.00.

method.description: How the amount is applied: Flat once, PerUnit times the unit, Percentage of the linehaul.

unit.description: How many units the charge covers; 1 for a flat charge.

baseRate.description: The rate the rating method prices with, as the person gave it: 2450 for a $2,450 flat load, 2.10 for $2.10 a mile.

billToCustomerId.description: Who is billed, when not the customer, from customer_list.

bol.description: The bill of lading number. It must be unique among open shipments, so never reuse one from another shipment. Optional unless the customer's billing requires a BOL; leave it out when none is known.

commodities.description: What is hauled, one line per commodity.

customerId.description: The customer, from customer_list.

externalReference.description: The customer's own order or load number, as it appears on their tender, email or rate confirmation. It is checked apart from the BOL, only against this customer's other live shipments, so a second booking of the same order is refused; keep it as written unless that refusal comes back, and leave it out when the customer gave none.

formulaTemplateId.description: The rating method that prices the freight, from formula_list_templates. Leave it out when the customer's rate agreement covers the lane, and the contract's is used.

freightTerms.description: Who pays the freight. Defaults to Prepaid.

moves.description: Usually one move, sequence 0. Each has its stops in travel order.

loaded.description: False for a deadhead move. Defaults to true.

sequence.description: The move's place, counting from 0. Leave it out to take the order given.

stops.description: The stops in travel order: a pickup first, a delivery last.

addressLine.description: A dock or suite note for the stop.

scheduleType.description: Open for a window, Appointment for a fixed time. Defaults to Open.

scheduledWindowEnd.description: When the stop's window closes: the deadline the person gave, or the end of the part of the day they named. A local date and time as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM with no UTC offset, such as 2026-10-01T08:00, read in the timezone of where it happens; never Unix seconds.

scheduledWindowStart.description: When the stop's window opens. A part of the day the person named is a window, not a question: morning 08:00 to 12:00, afternoon 13:00 to 17:00, evening 17:00 to 21:00. A deadline alone ("by 3pm", "by noon") opens at 08:00 that day and closes at the deadline. Use it and say which you used. A local date and time as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM with no UTC offset, such as 2026-10-01T08:00, read in the timezone of where it happens; never Unix seconds.

sequence.description: The stop's place in the move, counting from 0. Leave it out to take the order given.

pieces.description: The total piece or handling-unit count.

ratingUnit.description: How many units the rating method prices. Defaults to 1.

tractorTypeId.description: A tractor equipment type, from equipment_list_types.

trailerTypeId.description: A trailer equipment type, from equipment_list_types.

sourceDocumentId.description: The uploaded document this shipment was read from, when there is one: the documentId you read with intake_get_draft or agent_read_attachment, usually a file on the message, this run's subject or the page.

policy.rationale: A new load commits a customer's freight and the money that follows, so no desk books one unattended.

tools.name: shipment_create_recurring
tools.description: Start a recurring shipment: a series that copies one saved shipment on a schedule, for a customer's standing lane. Give the source shipment, a name, the cron schedule and its timezone, all from what the person or the customer asked for. It starts Active.

autoGenerate.description: Create each shipment on schedule without anyone asking. Off, a person generates each one.

blackoutDates.description: Days no shipment is generated, such as holidays.

items.description: A blackout day. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

cronExpression.description: When shipments repeat, as a five-field cron expression read in the series' timezone: "0 8 * * 1-5" is 08:00 every weekday. Take it from what the person or customer asked for.

description.description: Anything a planner should know about it.

endDate.description: The last day shipments may be generated, in the series' timezone. Leave out for no end. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

exceptionPolicy.description: What a shipment that falls on a blackout day or weekend does: Skip it, or move it to the business day before or after.

leadTimeDays.description: How many days before each pickup its shipment is created.

maxOccurrences.description: Stop after this many shipments. Leave out for no limit.

name.description: What dispatch calls the series, such as "Acme weekday Dallas run".

skipWeekends.description: Treat Saturday and Sunday like blackout days.

sourceShipmentId.description: The shipment every one copies (customer, stops, commodities and charges), from shipment_get, shipment_list or the page you are on. Never guess one.

startDate.description: The first day shipments may be generated, in the series' timezone. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

timezone.description: The IANA timezone the schedule is read in, such as America/Chicago.

policy.rationale: Sets up a schedule inside Trenova that creates shipments later; nothing is sent, and pausing the series stops it.

tools.name: shipment_delete_comment
tools.description: Delete a comment from a shipment's thread: your own, or another person's when the person you act for may moderate comments. One with replies is left as a placeholder so the replies keep their place. Prefer shipment_resolve_comment for a note that was right at the time.

commentId.description: The comment, from the recentComments shipment_get lists or the page you are on. Never guess one.

shipmentId.description: The shipment the comment is on, from shipment_get, shipment_list or the page you are on. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Removes a note from a shipment's own thread inside Trenova; the text is gone, so a person confirms it.

tools.name: shipment_duplicate
tools.description: Copy an existing shipment into new ones on the server, carrying its customer, stops, commodities, charges, freight terms and rating method exactly as saved. Prefer it to shipment_create whenever the freight repeats one already booked, since nothing is retyped. Give firstPickupAt to move every stop window so the first pickup starts then, in local time at that pickup; leave it out to keep the source's dates. A shipment nothing prices cannot be copied. Each copy gets its own pro number and order; they appear in shipment_list within a minute.

count.description: How many copies to make, 1 to 20. Defaults to 1.

firstPickupAt.description: When the copies' first pickup window starts; every other stop keeps its distance from it. Only from what the person asked for, never invented. A local date and time as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM with no UTC offset, such as 2026-10-01T08:00, read in the timezone of where it happens; never Unix seconds.

shipmentId.description: The shipment to copy, from shipment_get, shipment_list or the page you are on. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Creates new shipments inside Trenova from one already saved; nothing is sent, and a copy made in error is canceled.

tools.name: shipment_generate_recurring
tools.description: Create the shipment for a recurring shipment's next slot now, or for the slot at occurrenceAt, instead of waiting for the schedule. A slot that already has its shipment is not made twice.

occurrenceAt.description: The slot to generate, one the schedule produces. Leave out for the next one. A date and time with its UTC offset (RFC 3339), such as 2026-10-01T08:00:00-05:00.

recurringShipmentId.description: The series, from shipment_list_recurring. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Creates one shipment inside Trenova from the series' source; nothing is sent, and a shipment made in error is canceled.

tools.name: shipment_get
tools.description: Read one shipment (load) by its id or PRO number. It shows the customer and rating, each move's stops with their windows in the stop's local time, who drives it and with what equipment, the holds on it now and its newest comments. Pass detail full only for a field the summary leaves out. Each hold carries the holdId shipment_update_hold and shipment_release_hold take. Find it with shipment_list when you have only a customer, a place or a BOL.

detail.description: How much to return. Omit it for the summary: the customer, the rating, the moves with their stops, assignment and carrier, the commodities, charges, holds and comments. full returns every stored field.

proNumber.description: The PRO number, when that is what the person gave you.

shipmentId.description: The shipment's id, from shipment_list, the page you are on, or this run's subject. Give this or proNumber.

policy.rationale: Reads a shipment with its newest comments, some of which a driver, a trading partner or another system outside the organization wrote; nothing changes and nothing is sent.

tools.name: shipment_get_tracking
tools.description: Where a shipment is and whether it will be on time: each stop's window, actual arrival and lateness, the tractor's last position, and an arrival estimate. It also shows who is on each move with what truck and the driver's remaining hours. Each open stop carries its projected arrival, slack and verdict, worked out from the truck's position, the carrier's check calls or the last departure with routed drive time, dwell and the driver's hours; estimate.basis says what it rests on and estimate.inputStale says when that is old. Call it an estimate and never a promise. Start here for any "where is", "is it late" or "when will it arrive" question; shipment_get has the commercial detail instead.

proNumber.description: The PRO number, when that is what the person gave you.

shipmentId.description: The shipment's id, from shipment_list, the page you are on, or this run's subject. Give this or proNumber.

policy.rationale: Reads records the caller may already open; it changes nothing and sends nothing.

tools.name: shipment_list
tools.description: Find shipments (loads) by the words people use for them, by status, or by filters on dates, charges and transfer status. Words match a pro number or BOL, a customer's name or code, a stop's place or city, the driver or what it carries; several words each narrow, so "sunbelt chicago" finds Sunbelt's loads through Chicago. With no words and no filters it lists the newest. Each row has the first pickup, the final stop and who drives each move; open one with shipment_get only for more.

after.description: The nextCursor of the previous page, with every other argument unchanged; omit for the first page.

filters.description: Conditions beside status, combined with AND: billingTransferStatus (ReadyForReview|InReview|OnHold|Exception|SentBackToOps|Approved|Posted|Canceled; isnull means never transferred), freightTerms (Prepaid|Collect|ThirdParty), customerId (from customer_list, never guessed), proNumber, bol, the dates actualShipDate, actualDeliveryDate, billedAt, canceledAt and createdAt, and the numbers totalChargeAmount and weight. Give value for one comparison, values for in and notin, days for nextndays and lastndays, and nothing for isnull, isnotnull, today, yesterday and tomorrow. Dates: today, nextndays/lastndays with days, or YYYY-MM-DD; never Unix time.

limit.description: How many rows to return: 10 when you give words, 25 otherwise, at most 50.

query.description: Words to match: a pro number, BOL, customer, stop place or city, driver or commodity. Omit to list by status and filters alone.

sortBy.description: Field to order by. Defaults to most recently created.

sortDirection.description: asc for oldest or smallest first, desc for newest or largest.

status.description: Only shipments in these statuses, all in one call; omit for every status. Not picked up yet is New, PartiallyAssigned and Assigned; on the road is InTransit and Delayed. A load the person calls late or running behind is Delayed. There is no Delivered: a delivered load is Completed, ReadyToInvoice or Invoiced.

policy.rationale: Reads records the caller may already open; it changes nothing and sends nothing.

tools.name: shipment_list_permits
tools.description: List an oversize or overweight shipment's state permit requirements and the permits recorded against it. Each requirement has its state, status and lead time; each permit its number, dates and cost. It yields the stateId and permitId the permit tools take.

shipmentId.description: The shipment, from shipment_get, shipment_list or the page you are on. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Reads records the caller may already open; it changes nothing and sends nothing.

tools.name: shipment_list_recurring
tools.description: List recurring shipments: the series that copy one saved shipment on a schedule for a customer's standing lane, with when each next generates. Use the id with shipment_update_recurring, shipment_set_recurring_status or shipment_generate_recurring. Filters: status (Active|Paused|Expired): Paused generates nothing until resumed; Expired has ended; text: name; boolean: autoGenerate; date: nextOccurrenceAt, createdAt. Dates: today, nextndays/lastndays with days, or YYYY-MM-DD; never Unix time.

filters.description: Conditions, combined with AND. Give value for a single comparison, values for in and notin, days for nextndays and lastndays, and nothing at all for isnull, isnotnull, today, yesterday and tomorrow.

limit.description: How many rows to return: 25 unless you ask, at most 50.

offset.description: How many rows to skip. When a result says hasMore, call again with its nextOffset for the next page.

query.description: Optional free text matched across the searchable columns. Omit it when you are filtering on a field.

sortBy.description: Field to order by. Defaults to most recently created.

sortDirection.description: asc for oldest or smallest first, desc for newest or largest.

policy.rationale: Reads records the caller may already open; it changes nothing and sends nothing.

tools.name: shipment_match_records
tools.description: Match the customer, stop locations and commodities a new shipment names, in one call, and say which are missing. Each comes with its closest matches, and the answer lists the service types, shipment types, equipment types, location categories and rating methods to choose from. Use it before shipment_create instead of one list call per record.

commodities.description: What the load carries, by name.

customer.description: The customer the load is billed to, as the person or the document names it.

code.description: Optional: its code, when given.

name.description: The customer's name.

locations.description: Every stop's place, in travel order.

name.description: The facility or company name.

policy.rationale: Matches the records a new shipment names against the organization's own; nothing changes and nothing is sent.

tools.name: shipment_pin_comment
tools.description: Pin a comment to the top of a shipment's thread so dispatch sees it first. Use it for the note that says what the shipment is waiting on or how it must be handled. A reply cannot be pinned, and a shipment keeps at most twenty-five pinned.

commentId.description: The comment, from the recentComments shipment_get lists or the page you are on. Never guess one.

shipmentId.description: The shipment the comment is on, from shipment_get, shipment_list or the page you are on. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Orders a shipment's own comment thread inside Trenova; unpinning undoes it and nothing is sent.

tools.name: shipment_place_hold
tools.description: Put a shipment on hold so it stops moving, billing or delivering until someone clears it. The reason decides what the hold blocks, so call masterdata_list_hold_reasons first and use a real reason id rather than describing one.

holdReasonId.description: A hold reason id from masterdata_list_hold_reasons.

note.description: What prompted the hold, for whoever releases it. Say what would have to be true to clear it.

shipmentId.description: The shipment to hold, from the page, shipment_list.

policy.rationale: Places a hold on a shipment inside Trenova; no customer or EDI notice is sent.

tools.name: shipment_recalculate_distance
tools.description: Work out a shipment's move miles again from its stops through the organization's distance profile and routing provider, and save them. Use it after its stops changed and the miles on the board look wrong. It changes the miles only; the charges follow them the next time the shipment is rated.

shipmentId.description: The shipment, from shipment_get, shipment_list or the page you are on. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Re-derives the shipment's move distances inside Trenova from its stops; nothing is sent and running it again gives the same miles.

tools.name: shipment_record_permit
tools.description: Record an oversize or overweight permit a state issued for a shipment, from the permit in hand: the state, its number, status, dates, cost and conditions. The shipment's permit requirements are worked out again, so an active permit that covers the trip satisfies its state and can lift the permit hold on dispatch.

cost.description: What the state charged, as a decimal string such as 85.00.

expiresAt.description: When the permit stops covering the move. A date and time with its UTC offset (RFC 3339), such as 2026-10-01T08:00:00-05:00.

issuedAt.description: When the permit takes effect. A date and time with its UTC offset (RFC 3339), such as 2026-10-01T08:00:00-05:00.

note.description: Route conditions, escort or travel-time restrictions the permit carries.

permitNumber.description: The permit number exactly as the state printed it.

shipmentId.description: The shipment the permit covers, from shipment_get, shipment_list or the page you are on. Never guess one.

stateId.description: The state that issued it, as the stateId of the requirement it satisfies in shipment_list_permits. Never guess one.

status.description: Where the permit stands. An active permit records when it expires.

policy.rationale: Records a permit on the shipment inside Trenova, which can release a dispatch hold; nothing is sent to the state, and shipment_update_permit voids it.

tools.name: shipment_release_hold
tools.description: Clear a hold so the shipment can move again. Only release a hold whose reason you have confirmed is resolved — releasing one that still applies is how a shipment leaves without the paperwork it was waiting on.

holdId.description: The hold to release, from the holds shipment_get lists, the page or the event that started this run. Never guess one.

shipmentId.description: The shipment the hold is on, from the page, shipment_list or shipment_list.

policy.rationale: Releases a hold on a shipment inside Trenova; no customer or EDI notice is sent.

tools.name: shipment_request_documents
tools.description: Request missing documentation from a party by sending them an email. Use it when a POD, BOL or other paper a shipment needs has not arrived. Call inbox_list_email_profiles first for profileId; the organization's template adds the greeting, letterhead and sign-off. The email is sent and cannot be recalled.

body.description: The request in plain prose. The organization's template supplies the greeting, letterhead, and sign-off, so do not write them here.

customerName.description: Who is being asked, so the template can address them by name.

profileId.description: The email profile to send from, from inbox_list_email_profiles; pick billing for a document request when there is one.

requestedDocuments.description: The documents being asked for, one per entry. The template renders them as a list, so leave them out of the body prose.

shipmentProNumber.description: The shipment the documents belong to, so the recipient can find it.

subject.description: The subject line. The organization's template wraps it; do not add a company prefix.

policy.rationale: Emails an outside party a request for paperwork in words the model wrote.

tools.name: shipment_rerate
tools.description: Price a saved shipment again from its customer's rate agreement, replacing its rating method, base rate and contract accessorials. Use it when the lane, the stops or the agreement changed and the person wants the contract price back; read rate_explain first to see it. A shipment whose rate is locked or that is billed is refused, and one no contract covers is left as it is.

shipmentId.description: The shipment to re-rate, from shipment_get, shipment_list or the page you are on. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Changes what the customer will be billed for the shipment; nothing is invoiced or sent, and a person can edit the rate back.

tools.name: shipment_reschedule_stop
tools.description: Move a saved shipment's pickup or delivery appointment: the stop's planned window, local to the stop. Give the new window start; the window end moves with it, keeping its length, unless you give one. Take the stop id from shipment_get.

shipmentId.description: The shipment the stop is on, from shipment_list.

stopId.description: The stop to reschedule, from the moves' stops in shipment_get.

windowEnd.description: When it now closes, in the same local time. Leave it out to keep the window's length. A local date and time as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM with no UTC offset, such as 2026-10-01T08:00, read in the timezone of where it happens; never Unix seconds.

windowStart.description: When the stop's window now opens, in the stop location's local time. This is the plan; an actual arrival or departure goes to dispatch_record_stop_actual. A local date and time as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM with no UTC offset, such as 2026-10-01T08:00, read in the timezone of where it happens; never Unix seconds.

policy.rationale: A changed appointment is sent as an EDI tender change to the trading partners the load was tendered to.

tools.name: shipment_resolve_comment
tools.description: Mark a comment on a shipment resolved once what it asked for is done, or reopen one with resolved=false when it is not. Say what settled it in a reply with shipment_add_comment first, so the thread shows why.

commentId.description: The comment, from the recentComments shipment_get lists or the page you are on. Never guess one.

resolved.description: True to mark the comment resolved, false to reopen it. Defaults to true.

shipmentId.description: The shipment the comment is on, from shipment_get, shipment_list or the page you are on. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Marks a shipment's own comment settled inside Trenova; reopening undoes it and nothing is sent.

tools.name: shipment_revoke_tracking_link
tools.description: Stop every live customer tracking link on a shipment from working. Use it when a link reached the wrong person or the customer asks for access to end; share a new link afterwards if someone should keep following the load.

shipmentId.description: The shipment whose links to revoke, from the page, shipment_list or shipment_list.

policy.rationale: Ends the customer's access to the shipment's tracking page; a new link can be shared later.

tools.name: shipment_set_recurring_status
tools.description: Pause a recurring shipment so it creates nothing, resume it (Active) from its next future slot without back-filling what it missed, or end it (Expired). A resumed series with no slot left ends on its own.

recurringShipmentId.description: The series, from shipment_list_recurring. Never guess one.

status.description: The status to set.

policy.rationale: Starts or stops a schedule inside Trenova; nothing is sent, and the status is set back the same way.

tools.name: shipment_share_tracking_link
tools.description: Share a link to a shipment's tracking page with the customer, and email it when given an address. The page shows only what the customer's tracking settings allow and needs no sign-in. Use the address the customer asked you to send it to; never invent one.

recipientEmail.description: Where to email the link. Leave it out to share the link without emailing it.

shipmentId.description: The shipment to share, from the page, shipment_list.

policy.rationale: Gives the customer a link to the shipment's tracking page and can email it outside the organization; the link can be revoked.

tools.name: shipment_transfer_ownership
tools.description: Make another person the owner of a shipment, the one it is filed under and who is asked about it. Take the new owner from the person who asked or the ownerId shipment_get shows on another of the customer's shipments; never guess a user. Only the current owner or someone allowed to change the shipment may hand it on.

ownerId.description: The user who takes it over: the person who asked, or an ownerId shipment_get shows. Never guess one.

shipmentId.description: The shipment, from shipment_get, shipment_list or the page you are on. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Changes who owns a shipment inside Trenova; nothing is sent, and it is transferred back the same way.

tools.name: shipment_uncancel
tools.description: Reopen a canceled shipment as New, with its moves and stops back to New, when the person says the freight is back on. Nothing is sent to the customer, a carrier or a trading partner, and nobody is assigned: tender or assign it again afterwards. Read it with shipment_get first to be sure it is the canceled one.

shipmentId.description: The canceled shipment, from shipment_get, shipment_list or the page you are on. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Puts a canceled shipment back to New inside Trenova; nothing is sent, and canceling it again undoes it.

tools.name: shipment_unpin_comment
tools.description: Take a pinned comment off the top of a shipment's thread once what it said no longer applies.

commentId.description: The comment, from the recentComments shipment_get lists or the page you are on. Never guess one.

shipmentId.description: The shipment the comment is on, from shipment_get, shipment_list or the page you are on. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Orders a shipment's own comment thread inside Trenova; pinning again undoes it and nothing is sent.

tools.name: shipment_update
tools.description: Change the details of a saved shipment: the customer, service type, shipment type, equipment types, BOL, pieces, weight or temperature range. Send only the fields to change. Stops, moves, rates and status are not changed here: shipment_reschedule_stop moves an appointment, shipment_add_charge adds an accessorial, and the move, hold and cancel tools do the rest.

bol.description: The customer's BOL or reference number.

customerId.description: The new customer, from customer_list.

pieces.description: The total piece or handling-unit count. Leave it out to keep it.

serviceTypeId.description: The new service type, from masterdata_list_service_types.

shipmentId.description: The shipment to change, from the page, shipment_list.

shipmentTypeId.description: The new shipment type, from masterdata_list_shipment_types.

temperatureMin.description: Fahrenheit, with temperatureMax, for a load that needs temperature control. Leave both out to keep the load as it is.

tractorTypeId.description: The new tractor equipment type, from equipment_list_types.

trailerTypeId.description: The new trailer equipment type, from equipment_list_types.

weight.description: Pounds. Leave it out to keep it.

policy.rationale: A changed shipment is sent as an EDI tender change to the trading partners it was tendered to.

tools.name: shipment_update_comment
tools.description: Change the text, visibility, priority or acknowledgment request of a comment on a shipment. Send only what changes. Your own comments and those the person may moderate can be edited; a note widened past the organization's staff is read by whoever it is widened to, so only do it when asked.

commentId.description: The comment, from the recentComments shipment_get lists or the page you are on. Never guess one.

priority.description: How urgently dispatch should read it.

requiresAcknowledgment.description: Whether the people it mentions must acknowledge it.

shipmentId.description: The shipment the comment is on, from shipment_get, shipment_list or the page you are on. Never guess one.

visibility.description: Who sees it. Only widen it to a customer or a driver when the person asked.

policy.rationale: Edits a shipment's own comment inside Trenova; one made visible to a customer or a driver is read by them, so its visibility argument decides.

tools.name: shipment_update_hold
tools.description: Change an active hold on a shipment: its severity, its note, what it blocks (dispatch, delivery, billing) and whether the customer sees it. Send only what changes; everything else stays as it is. Use shipment_release_hold to clear a hold rather than unblocking everything. Making a hold visible to the customer is shown to them, so only do it when the person asked.

blocksBilling.description: Whether it stops the shipment being billed.

blocksDelivery.description: Whether it stops the shipment being delivered.

blocksDispatch.description: Whether it stops the shipment being dispatched.

holdId.description: The hold to change, from the holds shipment_get lists or the page you are on. Never guess one.

note.description: What the hold waits on, replacing the note on it.

shipmentId.description: The shipment the hold is on, from shipment_get, shipment_list or the page you are on. Never guess one.

visibleToCustomer.description: Whether the customer sees the hold.

policy.rationale: Changes a hold inside Trenova; one made visible to the customer is shown to them, so that call is held to the customer-visible ceiling.

tools.name: shipment_update_permit
tools.description: Correct or move on a permit recorded on a shipment: activate it when the state issues it, fix its number or dates, or void it. Give only what changes. The shipment's permit requirements are worked out again.

cost.description: What the state charged, as a decimal string such as 85.00.

expiresAt.description: When the permit stops covering the move. A date and time with its UTC offset (RFC 3339), such as 2026-10-01T08:00:00-05:00.

issuedAt.description: When the permit takes effect. A date and time with its UTC offset (RFC 3339), such as 2026-10-01T08:00:00-05:00.

note.description: Route conditions, escort or travel-time restrictions the permit carries.

permitId.description: The permit, from shipment_list_permits. Never guess one.

permitNumber.description: The permit number exactly as the state printed it.

shipmentId.description: The shipment the permit covers, from shipment_get, shipment_list or the page you are on. Never guess one.

stateId.description: The state that issued it, as the stateId of the requirement it satisfies in shipment_list_permits. Never guess one.

status.description: Where the permit stands. An active permit records when it expires.

policy.rationale: Changes a permit on the shipment inside Trenova, which can place or lift a dispatch hold; nothing is sent to the state, and it is changed again the same way.

tools.name: shipment_update_recurring
tools.description: Change a recurring shipment's name, schedule, timezone, dates, limits, blackout days or whether it generates on its own. Send only what changes; an empty endDate removes the end. Pause or resume it with shipment_set_recurring_status.

autoGenerate.description: Create each shipment on schedule without anyone asking. Off, a person generates each one.

blackoutDates.description: Days no shipment is generated, such as holidays.

items.description: A blackout day. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

cronExpression.description: When shipments repeat, as a five-field cron expression read in the series' timezone: "0 8 * * 1-5" is 08:00 every weekday. Take it from what the person or customer asked for.

description.description: Anything a planner should know about it.

endDate.description: The last day shipments may be generated, in the series' timezone. Leave out for no end. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

exceptionPolicy.description: What a shipment that falls on a blackout day or weekend does: Skip it, or move it to the business day before or after.

leadTimeDays.description: How many days before each pickup its shipment is created.

maxOccurrences.description: Stop after this many shipments. Leave out for no limit.

name.description: What dispatch calls the series, such as "Acme weekday Dallas run".

recurringShipmentId.description: The series to change, from shipment_list_recurring. Never guess one.

skipWeekends.description: Treat Saturday and Sunday like blackout days.

startDate.description: The first day shipments may be generated, in the series' timezone. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

timezone.description: The IANA timezone the schedule is read in, such as America/Chicago.

policy.rationale: Changes when a series creates shipments inside Trenova; nothing is sent, and the old schedule is set back the same way.

tools.name: web_list_portal_sites
tools.description: List the third-party web portals the organization set up for agents: warehouse dock-appointment portals, shipper and carrier portals, insurers' lookups. Each says what it is for, the addresses it lives on, whether it signs in and whether agents may act on it or only read it. Call it before web_read_portal or web_use_portal to find the site's id.

policy.rationale: Lists the portal sites an administrator set up; it changes nothing, sends nothing, and returns only what administrators wrote.

tools.name: web_list_watches
tools.description: List the web watches set for the person: what each watches for, how often and until when, how often it found something new, and whether it still runs. Call it before web_stop_watch to find a watch's id, or to answer what is being watched.

includeEnded.description: Also list watches that ended, were stopped or failed. Off unless asked about past watches.

policy.rationale: Lists the web watches set for the person; it changes nothing, reaches no one, and returns only what the agents wrote when they set them.

tools.name: web_read
tools.description: Read the text of a page that web_search returned, to check details its short passages left out. Takes the result's url and ref exactly as web_search gave them; it cannot open any other address. Long pages come in parts of about 8,000 characters. Cite what you use by linking to it.

part.description: Optional: which part of a long page to read, starting at 1. Ask for the next part only when the previous one said the page continues.

ref.description: The ref web_search returned with that url, copied exactly.

url.description: The page's url, copied exactly from a web_search result.

policy.rationale: Reads a page a web search returned; it changes nothing in Trenova and returns text written outside it.

tools.name: web_read_portal
tools.description: Look something up on an organization portal site through a cloud browser, such as open appointment slots, a load's status or a carrier's certificate. It returns what the portal shows, only reads, and never submits anything; to book, upload or accept, use web_use_portal. It takes up to four minutes. Ask one clear question and give the references the portal knows (PO, BOL, appointment number) in details, never Trenova record ids. A portal that texts or emails a sign-in code waits for the person to enter it. What it returns is written outside the organization.

details.description: Optional: the values the portal needs to find it, by what the portal calls them, such as {"PO number": "4512", "Warehouse": "Dallas DC"}.

question.description: What to find out, in one plain sentence, such as "Which dock appointment slots are open on October 20?".

siteId.description: The portal site to read, from web_list_portal_sites.

policy.rationale: Reads a third-party portal through the organization's extension; it changes nothing in Trenova, tells the browser to submit nothing, and returns text written outside it.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the public web for current information that is not in Trenova, such as regulations, agency guidance and industry news. Returns pages with short passages, government sites first and marked official. Use it for rules and facts outside the organization's own records instead of answering from memory, which may be out of date. The query leaves Trenova: never put record IDs, email addresses, phone numbers or private details about a customer, carrier or driver in it. Cite what you use by linking to it.

limit.description: Optional: how many pages to return, at most the organization's setting.

publishedWithinDays.description: Optional: only pages published in the last this many days, for news or recent rule changes. Leave it out for standing rules.

query.description: What to look up, in plain words, such as "FMCSA ELD malfunction rules" or "IFTA quarterly filing deadlines". General terms only.

policy.rationale: Searches the public web through the organization's extension; it changes nothing in Trenova, sends only the query, and returns text written outside it.

tools.name: web_stop_watch
tools.description: Stop a web watch the person no longer needs, so the vendor stops searching and billing for it. Find its id with web_list_watches.

watchId.description: The web watch to stop, from web_list_watches.

policy.rationale: Stops a scheduled search the person set; it changes no record and reaches nobody.

tools.name: web_use_portal
tools.description: Propose doing one thing on an organization portal site through a cloud browser, such as booking a dock appointment or accepting a load. It can also move an appointment, upload a proof of delivery or update a status. A person sees the exact instruction and details the browser will get and decides; once approved the portal does it in the background and you pick the work up with what it said. Only sites that allow actions can take one. Give one action per proposal, and the references the portal knows in details, never Trenova record ids.

details.description: The values the portal needs, by what the portal calls them, such as {"PO number": "4512", "Carrier": "Ridgeline Freight"}.

instruction.description: Exactly what to do, in one plain sentence, such as "Book the 8:00 AM dock appointment on October 20 for this PO".

siteId.description: The portal site to act on, from web_list_portal_sites. It must allow actions.

policy.rationale: Acts on a third-party portal in the organization's name, which another company then relies on; what it books or submits is undone, if at all, on that portal. A person always decides.

tools.name: web_watch
tools.description: Keep watching the web for something new for the person, such as a rule being finalized, a carrier or customer in the news, or a rate change announced. The organization's research vendor runs the search on a schedule and hands back only pages it has not found before, and this conversation picks the work up with them. Use it when the person asks to be told when something happens; for a question about now, use web_search. A watch lasts 30 days unless asked otherwise.

cadence.description: How often to look. Daily unless the person needs to hear sooner or less often.

days.description: How many days to keep watching, from 1 to 90. Defaults to 30.

purpose.description: What the person wants to hear about, in their terms, such as "FMCSA finalizing the broker transparency rule".

query.description: The search to run each time, written as a description of the pages wanted, such as "FMCSA final rule broker transparency 49 CFR 371.3". Never a Trenova record id.

sites.description: Optional: search only these sites, such as ["fmcsa.dot.gov", "federalregister.gov"].

policy.rationale: Sets a scheduled search on the organization's web research vendor for the person; it changes no record, reaches nobody, and ends on its own or when stopped.
Takes back a proposal the agent filed earlier in the same turn, before anyone has seen it; it changes no record and only narrows what the person is asked.

tools.name: worker_adjust_pto_balance
tools.description: Draft a manual adjustment to a worker's time-off balance, in days, for a person to approve. Positive days add and negative days take away, with a note saying why, such as a balance carried over from a previous system.

amountDays.description: Days to add, or a negative number of days to take away, such as 1.5 or -2.

effectiveDate.description: The day it takes effect. Defaults to today. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

note.description: Why, kept on the ledger. Required.

workerId.description: The driver, from worker_list. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Changes how many paid days a worker holds, which the organization owes and may pay out, so a person approves it and it runs as them.

tools.name: worker_approve_pto
tools.description: Approve a worker's time-off request. Approving books the days against their balance and takes them off the board for those dates. When you hold worker_get_schedule, say what they are covering on those days beside the proposal; when you do not, propose it anyway and say coverage was not checked, since the person approving weighs it. Only a request still awaiting a decision can be approved; for several, propose each.

ptoId.description: The id of the time-off request, from worker_list_time_off. A worker id is not a request id.

reason.description: An optional note recorded with the decision. Leave it out unless you were given one.

policy.rationale: Books approved time off; the worker is told it was approved but reads no text the model wrote.

tools.name: worker_approve_shift_swap
tools.description: Approve a shift swap the other worker has accepted, so the day changes hands on the rota. Only a person approves one.

note.description: What the workers are told about it.

swapId.description: The swap, from worker_get_schedule. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Changes who works a day; approving is the office's decision, so only a person makes it.

tools.name: worker_archive_credential
tools.description: Archive a credential that no longer applies, such as an endorsement the driver surrendered, with the reason. A required credential archived with no replacement leaves the worker out of compliance.

credentialId.description: The credential, from worker_list_credentials. Never guess one.

reason.description: Why it is archived.

policy.rationale: Retires a credential inside Trenova, which can take the worker off dispatch; the archived row stays on file, and a new credential is recorded to replace it.

tools.name: worker_assign_required_training
tools.description: Assign a worker every course the organization requires of them that they are missing, have failed or have let lapse. Courses already open are left alone. The driver sees each assignment in Dash.

workerId.description: The driver, from worker_list. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Assigns the courses the worker's driver type requires; the driver sees them in Dash, and cancel_worker_training withdraws one.

tools.name: worker_assign_shift
tools.description: Put a worker on a shift pattern from a day onward. The pattern they are on now ends the day before; a worker who already has a pattern starting on or after that day is refused. Take the shift from worker_list_shift_templates and the day from what the person asked for.

cycleOffsetWeeks.description: Which week of a rotating pattern the worker starts on, 0 for the first.

effectiveFrom.description: The first day the worker works it. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

note.description: Anything the planner should know.

shiftTemplateId.description: The shift pattern, from worker_list_shift_templates. Never guess one.

workerId.description: The driver, from worker_list. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Changes a worker's standing schedule inside Trenova; nothing is sent, and worker_end_shift_assignment or a new assignment changes it back.

tools.name: worker_assign_training
tools.description: Assign one or more training courses to one or more workers, due on the day given or on the course's own schedule. A course a worker already has open is left as it is. The driver sees each assignment in Dash.

dueDate.description: When it is due, when not the course's own schedule. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

note.description: Anything the assignment should say.

policy.rationale: Assigns courses the driver sees in Dash; cancel_worker_training withdraws one.

tools.name: worker_attach_credential_document
tools.description: Attach a scan of the card or certificate, already filed on the worker, to a credential. A new document on a verified credential clears the verification.

credentialId.description: The credential, from worker_list_credentials. Never guess one.

documentId.description: A document already filed on the worker, from document_list. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Links a filed document to a credential inside Trenova; attaching another replaces it.

tools.name: worker_attach_training_document
tools.description: Attach a certificate or sign-in sheet already filed on the worker to one of their training assignments.

documentId.description: A document already filed on the worker, from document_list. Never guess one.

trainingRecordId.description: The training assignment, from worker_list_training. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Links a filed document to a training record inside Trenova; attaching another replaces it.

tools.name: worker_cancel_checklist
tools.description: Cancel an open checklist that no longer applies, with the reason kept. Its items stay as they were.

checklistId.description: The checklist, from worker_list_checklists. Never guess one.

reason.description: Why it no longer applies.

policy.rationale: Cancels a checklist inside Trenova; nothing is sent, and a cancelled checklist is started again from its template.

tools.name: worker_cancel_dot_random_draw
tools.description: Cancel a random testing round, draft or final, so the period can be drawn again. The round and the reason stay on the record.

drawId.description: The round, from worker_list_dot_random_draws. Never guess one.

reason.description: Why the round is cancelled.

policy.rationale: Voids a round so the period is drawn again; the cancelled round and its reason stay on the record, and it cannot be undone.

tools.name: worker_cancel_dot_test
tools.description: Cancel a drug or alcohol test that did not happen, with the reason kept on the record. A test with a result cannot be cancelled; a correction is a new test.

reason.description: Why the collection did not happen.

testId.description: The test, from worker_list_dot_tests. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Voids a scheduled collection; the row and its reason stay on the record an auditor reads, and it cannot be undone.

tools.name: worker_cancel_pto
tools.description: Cancel a worker's time off, whether it was still awaiting a decision or already approved. Cancelling approved time off returns the days to their balance and puts them back on the board for those dates.

ptoId.description: The id of the time-off request, from worker_list_time_off. A worker id is not a request id.

reason.description: Why it is being cancelled. Recorded with the change.

policy.rationale: The worker is sent the cancellation reason by push notice and text message.

tools.name: worker_close_leave_case
tools.description: Close a decided leave case once the leave is over. The days recorded against it stay counted. A case still waiting for a decision is refused. Only a person's approval runs it.

leaveCaseId.description: The leave case, from worker_list_leave_cases. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Closes a leave case under the leave approval grant, so it runs as the person who approves it; the days it drew down stay drawn down.

tools.name: worker_close_training
tools.description: Close an open training assignment without a completion. Waive satisfies the requirement for a stated reason, such as an equivalent certificate on file; Cancel withdraws an assignment that should never have been made.

reason.description: Why. Required to waive; what the record will say.

trainingRecordId.description: The training assignment, from worker_list_training. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Closes a training assignment inside Trenova; the reason stays on the record, and the course is assigned again the same way.

tools.name: worker_delete_employment_verification
tools.description: Remove a previous employer filed on the qualification file in error, such as a duplicate. A settled investigation is corrected, not removed.

verificationId.description: The previous employer's verification, from worker_list_employment_verifications. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Removes a previous employer from the qualification file; the audit trail keeps what was removed.

tools.name: worker_delete_injury
tools.description: Delete an injury case entered on the log in error, such as a duplicate. Its case number is not reused. A real case is corrected, never deleted.

injuryId.description: The injury case, from worker_list_injuries. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Removes a case from the OSHA log; the audit trail keeps what was removed, and the number is not given out again.

tools.name: worker_delete_leave_day
tools.description: Remove a day of leave recorded in error, which gives its hours back to the worker's entitlement.

leaveDayId.description: The day of leave, from worker_list_leave_cases. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Removes a recorded day of leave; the audit trail keeps what was removed, and worker_record_leave_day records it again.

tools.name: worker_delete_performance_review
tools.description: Delete a draft performance review started in error. A submitted review is part of the record and is refused.

reviewId.description: The review, from worker_list_performance_reviews. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Removes a draft review nobody has seen; the audit trail keeps what was removed.

tools.name: worker_delete_recognition
tools.description: Remove a recognition given in error. If it was visible, it leaves the driver's record in Dash too.

recognitionId.description: The recognition, from worker_list_safety_events. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Removes a recognition from a driver's record; it is given again the same way.

tools.name: worker_delete_safety_event
tools.description: Delete a safety event recorded in error, taking its points off the driver's record. A closed event is history and is refused: reopen it first if it truly never happened.

safetyEventId.description: The safety event, from worker_list_safety_events. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Removes an event recorded in error from a driver's safety record; the audit trail keeps what was deleted, and it cannot be put back.

tools.name: worker_delete_safety_violation
tools.description: Remove a roadside violation cited on a safety event in error, taking it out of the fleet's CSA BASIC scores.

violationId.description: The violation, from worker_list_safety_events. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Removes a cited violation inside Trenova; the audit trail keeps what was removed, and it is cited again with worker_record_safety_violation.

tools.name: worker_end_shift_assignment
tools.description: End a worker's shift pattern after a day, leaving them on no pattern from the day after. Use worker_assign_shift instead to move them onto another pattern.

effectiveTo.description: The last day the worker works the pattern. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

shiftAssignmentId.description: The assignment, from worker_get_schedule. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Ends a worker's standing schedule inside Trenova; nothing is sent, and worker_assign_shift puts them back on it.

tools.name: worker_finalize_dot_random_draw
tools.description: Finalize a draft random testing round so its selections stand as the evidence of the period. A final round is never re-drawn; a mistake is corrected by cancelling it. Only a person's approval runs it.

drawId.description: The round, from worker_list_dot_random_draws. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Locks the round's selections as the record an auditor reads; it cannot be undone, only cancelled, so a person approves it.

tools.name: worker_get
tools.description: Retrieve one worker (driver) by id, including their profile and current state. Use worker_list with a query first when you only have a name.

workerId.description: The worker's id, from worker_list, the page you are on, or this run's subject.

policy.rationale: Reads records the caller may already open; it changes nothing and sends nothing.

tools.name: worker_get_credential
tools.description: Retrieve one worker credential by id: its type, the worker who holds it, its status, and when it was issued and expires. It also says whether it was verified and whether a document is on file. Use worker_list_credentials first when you do not have an id.

credentialId.description: The worker credential's id, from worker_list_credentials or the page you are on.

policy.rationale: Reads records the caller may already open; it changes nothing and sends nothing.

tools.name: worker_get_dot_random_draw
tools.description: Retrieve one random testing round with every driver it selected. Each selection has its substance, rank and where it stands: selected, notified, completed with its test, excused or missed. It yields the drawEntryId worker_schedule_dot_test and worker_update_dot_random_selection take.

drawId.description: The round, from worker_list_dot_random_draws. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Reads records the caller may already open; it changes nothing and sends nothing.

tools.name: worker_get_hos
tools.description: A driver's hours of service as the ELD last reported them: duty status and the drive, shift, cycle and break time remaining, in minutes. Use it before promising a delivery time or proposing an assignment. A reading older than twelve hours is marked stale and should not be planned on.

workerId.description: The driver's id, from worker_list.

policy.rationale: Reads records the caller may already open; it changes nothing and sends nothing.

tools.name: worker_get_schedule
tools.description: Read one worker's schedule: the shift patterns they have been on (the current one open-ended), what they said about each weekday, and their open shift swaps. It gives the shiftAssignmentId and swapId the scheduling tools take.

workerId.description: The worker, from worker_list.

policy.rationale: Reads records the caller may already open; it changes nothing and sends nothing.

tools.name: worker_list_checklists
tools.description: List one worker's onboarding, offboarding and other checklists with every item and where it stands, and the templates a person can start by hand. It yields the checklistId, checklistItemId and templateId the checklist tools take.

includeClosed.description: Also the completed and cancelled checklists, not only the open ones. Defaults to false, the open ones only.

workerId.description: The worker, from worker_list. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Reads records the caller may already open; it changes nothing and sends nothing.

tools.name: worker_list_credentials
tools.description: List worker credentials: one worker's licences, medical cards and endorsements, or those falling due across the organization. With a worker and no expiry window it returns every credential the worker holds, with its dates and whether it is verified, and the credential types the organization tracks; a required type with nothing on file was never recorded, which is worse than expiring soon. Without a worker, or with expiringWithinDays or includeExpired, it lists active credentials expiring within that many days from now, soonest first, a page at a time: the tool for any question about who is expiring, lapsed or out of compliance by a date. Narrow to one kind with credentialTypeCode, such as MED_CARD for a medical card or CDL for a licence. It yields the credentialId and credentialTypeId the credential tools take.

after.description: The nextCursor of the previous page, with every other argument unchanged; omit for the first page.

credentialTypeCode.description: Only credentials of this type, by its code, such as MED_CARD or CDL, in any case. Only records whose credential type code contains this text.

expiringWithinDays.description: Only active credentials expiring within this many days from now, from 1 to 365. 30 when no worker is named.

includeArchived.description: With a worker and no expiry window, also read their archived credentials.

includeExpired.description: With an expiry window, also those that lapsed in the last 90 days.

limit.description: How many rows to return: 25 unless you ask, at most 100.

requiredOnly.description: Only credential types the organization marks required.

workerId.description: The worker, from worker_list. Never guess one. Leave it out for the credentials falling due across the organization.

policy.rationale: Reads records the caller may already open; it changes nothing and sends nothing.

tools.name: worker_list_dot_random_draws
tools.description: List the random drug and alcohol testing pools and the rounds drawn from them. Pools carry their annual rates; rounds, newest first, are draft, final or cancelled, with how many drivers each substance needed and got. It yields the poolId and drawId the random testing tools take; worker_get_dot_random_draw names who was picked.

policy.rationale: Reads records the caller may already open; it changes nothing and sends nothing.

tools.name: worker_list_dot_tests
tools.description: List drug and alcohol tests, newest first: one worker's, or every collection still open across the organization. Each row has the test type, why it was ordered, its status and dates; the substance and result are shown only where access reaches Restricted. It yields the testId worker_cancel_dot_test takes.

limit.description: How many rows to return: 25 unless you ask, at most 100.

openOnly.description: Only the collections not yet completed or cancelled.

workerId.description: The worker, from worker_list. Never guess one. Leave it out for every worker's.

policy.rationale: Reads records the caller may already open; it changes nothing and sends nothing.

tools.name: worker_list_employment_verifications
tools.description: List the previous employers on drivers' qualification files. Each shows where its safety performance history request stands: asked when, followed up how often, and what came back. It yields the verificationId the verification tools take.

limit.description: How many rows to return: 25 unless you ask, at most 100.

outstandingOnly.description: Only the employers who have not answered yet.

workerId.description: The worker, from worker_list. Never guess one. Leave it out for every worker's.

policy.rationale: Reads records the caller may already open; it changes nothing and sends nothing.

tools.name: worker_list_injuries

limit.description: How many rows to return: 25 unless you ask, at most 100.

recordableOnly.description: Only the cases that belong on the OSHA 300 log.

workerId.description: The worker, from worker_list. Never guess one. Leave it out for every worker's.
