tools.name: worker_list_leave_cases
tools.description: List FMLA, medical, military, parental and personal leave cases. Cases for one worker or the whole organization come with their status, certification and each day taken against them. It yields the leaveCaseId and leaveDayId the leave tools take.

certificationOutstandingOnly.description: Only the cases still waiting on the certification the worker owes.

limit.description: How many rows to return: 25 unless you ask, at most 100.

openOnly.description: Only the cases still pending or approved.

workerId.description: The worker, from worker_list. Never guess one. Leave it out for every worker's.

policy.rationale: Reads records the caller may already open; it changes nothing and sends nothing.

tools.name: worker_list_performance_reviews
tools.description: List one worker's performance reviews with each item's key, score and comment, the summary and goals, and the review templates in use. It yields the reviewId and templateId the review tools take, and the rating keys worker_update_performance_review scores.

workerId.description: The worker, from worker_list. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Reads records the caller may already open; it changes nothing and sends nothing.

tools.name: worker_list_safety_events
tools.description: List safety events newest first: one worker's, or, leaving out the worker, those still open across the fleet. One worker's come with their roadside violations and recognitions; the fleet's each name the driver. Events are accidents, inspections, citations, complaints and near misses with their points and status. It yields the safetyEventId, violationId and recognitionId the safety tools take.

limit.description: How many rows to return: 25 unless you ask, at most 100.

openOnly.description: Only the events still open or under review. Defaults to true when no worker is named, and to false for one worker's; set it to false for the fleet's closed events too.

workerId.description: The worker, from worker_list. Never guess one. Leave it out for every worker's.

policy.rationale: Reads records the caller may already open; it changes nothing and sends nothing.

tools.name: worker_list_shift_templates
tools.description: List the organization's active shift patterns: the days, start time and length of each, and how many weeks it rotates over. worker_assign_shift takes the id.

policy.rationale: Reads records the caller may already open; it changes nothing and sends nothing.

tools.name: worker_list_time_off
tools.description: List worker (driver) time-off requests: who is out, who is asking to be, and who was turned down. The tool for availability by date, and the one that yields the request ids the approve, reject and cancel tools need. Filters: autoApproved, createdAtFrom/To, daysMin/Max, endDateFrom/To, hasApprover, hasCancelledBy, hasRejector, hasWorker, overlapping, startDateFrom/To, status, type, updatedAtFrom/To, workerId.

after.description: The nextCursor of the previous page, with every other argument unchanged; omit for the first page.

autoApproved.description: true for only the records whose autoApproved is true, false for only those whose autoApproved is false.

balanceAfterDaysMax.description: Only records whose balance after days is at most this. Write it as a decimal, such as 1250.00.

balanceAfterDaysMin.description: Only records whose balance after days is at least this. Write it as a decimal, such as 1250.00.

cancellationReason.description: Only records whose cancellation reason contains this text.

createdAtFrom.description: Only records whose created at is on or after this day, in the organization's timezone. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

createdAtTo.description: Only records whose created at is on or before this day, in the organization's timezone. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

daysMax.description: Only records whose days is at most this. Write it as a decimal, such as 1250.00.

daysMin.description: Only records whose days is at least this. Write it as a decimal, such as 1250.00.

endDateFrom.description: Only records whose end date is on or after this day, in the organization's timezone. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

endDateTo.description: Only records whose end date is on or before this day, in the organization's timezone. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

hasApprover.description: true for only records that have a approver, false for only those that have none.

hasCancelledBy.description: true for only records that have a cancelled by, false for only those that have none.

hasRejector.description: true for only records that have a rejector, false for only those that have none.

hasWorker.description: true for only records that have a worker, false for only those that have none.

limit.description: How many rows to return: 25 unless you ask, at most 50.

overlapping.description: true matches leave on at any point between startDateFrom and startDateTo, including leave that began before startDateFrom and is still running; false matches only leave that starts in that window. Defaults to true.

query.description: Optional free text matched across the searchable columns. Omit it when you are narrowing by a field.

reason.description: Only records whose reason contains this text.

rejectionReason.description: Only records whose rejection reason contains this text.

sortBy.description: Field to order by. Defaults to most recently created.

sortDirection.description: asc for oldest or smallest first, desc for newest or largest.

startDateFrom.description: Only records whose start date is this day or later, in the organization's timezone. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01. Give neither date for leave on at any point from today through 14 days out.

startDateTo.description: Only records whose start date is this day or earlier, in the organization's timezone. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

status.description: Only records whose status is one of these. Requested means still awaiting a decision.

type.description: Only records whose type is one of these.

updatedAtFrom.description: Only records whose updated at is on or after this day, in the organization's timezone. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

updatedAtTo.description: Only records whose updated at is on or before this day, in the organization's timezone. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

workerId.description: The worker, from worker_list. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Reads records the caller may already open; it changes nothing and sends nothing.

tools.name: worker_list_training
tools.description: List one worker's training assignments with each course, its status, due date, completion, score and when it expires. It yields the trainingRecordId the training tools take.

includeClosed.description: Also the completed, waived, cancelled and expired assignments, not only the open ones. Defaults to false, the open ones only.

workerId.description: The worker, from worker_list. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Reads records the caller may already open; it changes nothing and sends nothing.

tools.name: worker_list_training_courses
tools.description: List the organization's training courses with their category, delivery, passing score, how long a pass lasts and whether they are required. It yields the courseId the training tools take. Filters: category, code, contentUrl, createdAtFrom/To, delivery, description, dueDaysAfterAssignmentMin/Max, durationMinutesMin/Max, isRequired, name, passingScoreMin/Max, renewalWindowDaysMin/Max, requiresAcknowledgement, sortOrderMin/Max, status, updatedAtFrom/To, validityMonthsMin/Max.

after.description: The nextCursor of the previous page, with every other argument unchanged; omit for the first page.

category.description: Only records whose category is one of these.

code.description: Only records whose code contains this text.

contentUrl.description: Only records whose content url contains this text.

createdAtFrom.description: Only records whose created at is on or after this day, in the organization's timezone. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

createdAtTo.description: Only records whose created at is on or before this day, in the organization's timezone. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

delivery.description: Only records whose delivery is one of these.

description.description: Only records whose description contains this text.

dueDaysAfterAssignmentMax.description: Only records whose due days after assignment is at most this.

dueDaysAfterAssignmentMin.description: Only records whose due days after assignment is at least this.

durationMinutesMax.description: Only records whose duration minutes is at most this.

durationMinutesMin.description: Only records whose duration minutes is at least this.

isRequired.description: true for only the records whose isRequired is true, false for only those whose isRequired is false.

limit.description: How many rows to return: 25 unless you ask, at most 50.

name.description: Only records whose name contains this text.

passingScoreMax.description: Percentage a completion must reach; null for pass/fail-free courses. Only records whose passing score is at most this. Write it as a decimal, such as 1250.00.

passingScoreMin.description: Percentage a completion must reach; null for pass/fail-free courses. Only records whose passing score is at least this. Write it as a decimal, such as 1250.00.

query.description: Optional free text matched across the searchable columns. Omit it when you are narrowing by a field.

renewalWindowDaysMax.description: Only records whose renewal window days is at most this.

renewalWindowDaysMin.description: Only records whose renewal window days is at least this.

requiresAcknowledgement.description: true for only the records whose requiresAcknowledgement is true, false for only those whose requiresAcknowledgement is false.

sortBy.description: Field to order by. Defaults to most recently created.

sortDirection.description: asc for oldest or smallest first, desc for newest or largest.

sortOrderMax.description: Only records whose sort order is at most this.

sortOrderMin.description: Only records whose sort order is at least this.

status.description: Only records whose status is one of these. Defaults to Active, the courses in use; name Inactive too for retired ones.

updatedAtFrom.description: Only records whose updated at is on or after this day, in the organization's timezone. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

updatedAtTo.description: Only records whose updated at is on or before this day, in the organization's timezone. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

validityMonthsMax.description: Months a completion stays valid; null for one-time courses. Only records whose validity months is at most this.

validityMonthsMin.description: Months a completion stays valid; null for one-time courses. Only records whose validity months is at least this.

policy.rationale: Reads records the caller may already open; it changes nothing and sends nothing.

tools.name: worker_open_leave_case
tools.description: Open a leave case for a worker who asked for FMLA, medical, military, parental or personal leave, from the day it starts. The case waits for a decision a person makes; the days taken are recorded against it with worker_record_leave_day.

documentId.description: A document already filed on the worker, from document_list. Never guess one.

eligibilityHoursWorked.description: Hours worked in the twelve months before, for eligibility.

endsAt.description: The last day of leave, when it is known. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

militaryCaregiver.description: Whether it is leave to care for a covered servicemember.

note.description: Anything the case should say.

reason.description: Why, as the worker gave it. Keep medical detail out; the certification carries that.

requestedAt.description: The day the worker asked. Defaults to today. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

startsAt.description: The first day of leave. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

workerId.description: The driver, from worker_list. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Files a pending leave request inside Trenova; nothing is decided or sent, and the case is corrected with worker_update_leave_case.

tools.name: worker_open_safety_event
tools.description: Record a safety event on a driver's record: an accident, incident, near miss, citation or roadside inspection, with when and what happened. It opens Open and counts its points on the driver's scorecard; roadside violations cited on an inspection are added after with worker_record_safety_violation.

costAmount.description: What it cost the company, as a decimal such as 1800.00.

description.description: What happened, in the words of the report or the person who told you.

documentId.description: A document already filed on the worker, from document_list. Never guess one.

fineAmount.description: A fine, as a decimal such as 250.00.

inspectionLevel.description: For an inspection: its CVSA level.

inspectionResult.description: For an inspection: how it ended.

occurredAt.description: When it happened. A date and time with its UTC offset (RFC 3339), such as 2026-10-01T08:00:00-05:00.

outOfService.description: Whether the driver or the vehicle was put out of service.

points.description: The points it carries on the driver's record. Leave it out on a new event to take the house scale for the kind and severity.

preventable.description: For an accident: whether it was preventable. Leave it out unless the report says so.

referenceNumber.description: A citation, report or inspection number.

shipmentId.description: The load it happened on, from shipment_list or shipment_get. Never guess one.

workerId.description: The driver, from worker_list. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Adds an event to a driver's safety record inside Trenova; nothing is sent to the driver, and it is corrected or deleted while it is open.

tools.name: worker_place_dispatch_hold
tools.description: Stop a driver being given new freight, because a credential that governs driving has expired or will expire before a renewal could land. Say which paper and when it lapsed. This is reversible and a person can lift it; it does not touch the driver's employment or their current load.

reason.description: Which paper lapsed and when, in a sentence a dispatcher can read on the board.

workerId.description: The driver to hold, from worker_get.

policy.rationale: Keeps a driver off new freight inside Trenova; the driver is not messaged.

tools.name: worker_record_credential
tools.description: Record a driver's licence, medical card, endorsement, TWIC or other credential, or renew the one on file. What the person says is enough: only the worker and the kind are required, and dates they give ("good till oct 9 2028") go in as said; the number, issuer and a scan can follow. Set renew when one of the same kind is on file. A person verifies it against the original; recording is not verifying.

credentialTypeId.description: The kind of credential, from worker_list_credentials. Never guess one.

documentId.description: A document already filed on the worker, from document_list. Never guess one.

expiresAt.description: When it expires. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

issuedAt.description: When it was issued. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

issuingAuthority.description: Who issued it, such as the state.

note.description: Anything the credential should say.

number.description: The number on the card or certificate, exactly as printed.

renew.description: Whether this renews the worker's current credential of the same kind, which is archived as superseded. A second active one is refused without it.

workerId.description: The driver, from worker_list. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Adds a credential to the worker's file inside Trenova, which can change whether they may be dispatched; nothing is sent, and worker_archive_credential retires it.

tools.name: worker_record_employment_verification
tools.description: File a previous employer on a driver's qualification file so their safety performance history can be asked for (49 CFR 391.23), with who to ask and the dates of employment from the application. It starts Pending; worker_record_employment_verification_request records the request going out.

contactEmail.description: Their email address, as the application gives it.

contactPhone.description: Their phone number, as the application gives it.

employedFrom.description: When the worker started there. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

employedTo.description: When the worker left. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

note.description: Anything the file should say.

wasDotRegulated.description: Whether the job was DOT-regulated, which brings the drug and alcohol questions in.

workerId.description: The driver, from worker_list. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Adds a previous employer to the qualification file inside Trenova; nothing is sent to the employer, and it is corrected or removed the same way.

tools.name: worker_record_employment_verification_request
tools.description: Record that a previous employer was asked for the driver's safety performance history today (Requested), or chased again when they have not answered (FollowUp). Each follow-up is counted and dated as the good-faith effort 49 CFR 391.23 asks for. Sending the request is done by the person; this keeps the date.

verificationId.description: The previous employer's verification, from worker_list_employment_verifications. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Stamps the request date or counts a follow-up inside Trenova; nothing is sent to the employer.

tools.name: worker_record_injury
tools.description: Enter a work-related injury or illness on the OSHA injury log as a new case. It takes the next case number for its year and records when and how it happened, the treatment, the days away or restricted, and the workers' comp claim. Medical detail stays with people who hold the injury permission.

bodyPart.description: The part of the body affected.

claimFiledAt.description: When the claim was filed. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

claimStatus.description: Where the workers' comp claim stands.

classification.description: How the case is classified on the OSHA 300 log. Recordability is the employer's judgement: leave it out unless a person gave it, and the case takes the classification the treatment suggests.

daysAway.description: Days away from work, capped at 180 as the log counts them.

daysRestricted.description: Days on restricted duty or job transfer.

description.description: What happened and the injury, as reported.

documentId.description: A document already filed on the worker, from document_list. Never guess one.

harmfulAgent.description: What harmed the worker, such as a load strap.

illnessType.description: Injury, or the kind of illness.

note.description: Anything the case should say.

occurredAt.description: When it happened. A date and time with its UTC offset (RFC 3339), such as 2026-10-01T08:00:00-05:00.

privacyCase.description: Whether the worker's name is withheld from the log as a privacy case.

reportedAt.description: When the worker reported it. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

returnedToWorkAt.description: When the worker came back to work. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

safetyEventId.description: The accident it came from, from worker_list_safety_events.

workerId.description: The driver, from worker_list. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Adds a case to the organization's OSHA log inside Trenova; nothing is sent, and it is corrected with worker_update_injury.

tools.name: worker_record_leave_day
tools.description: Record a day of leave taken against an open or approved leave case, with the hours. Whether it counts against the FMLA entitlement follows the case as it stands today.

hours.description: Hours taken that day, such as 8 or 4.5.

leaveCaseId.description: The leave case, from worker_list_leave_cases. Never guess one.

note.description: Anything the day should say.

ptoId.description: Paid time off booked for the same day, from worker_list_time_off, when the leave runs concurrently.

usedOn.description: The day the leave was taken. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

policy.rationale: Records a day taken against a leave case inside Trenova; nothing is sent, and worker_update_leave_day or worker_delete_leave_day corrects it.

tools.name: worker_record_recognition
tools.description: Recognise a driver for a safety milestone, customer praise, performance or tenure. When it is visible to the driver, which is the default, they are told in Dash with the title and message you write, so write it as you would say it to them.

message.description: What you would say to them.

occurredAt.description: When it was earned. Defaults to now. A date and time with its UTC offset (RFC 3339), such as 2026-10-01T08:00:00-05:00.

title.description: A short title the driver sees.

visibleToWorker.description: Whether the driver sees it and is told. Defaults to true.

workerId.description: The driver, from worker_list. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: The driver is shown the recognition and told of it in Dash when it is visible to them.

tools.name: worker_record_safety_violation
tools.description: Cite one roadside violation on a safety event, usually an inspection, with its BASIC, the regulation, the severity weight and whether it was out of service. An inspection that cited several gets one call each. It feeds the fleet's CSA BASIC scores.

basic.description: The BASIC it falls under. Leave it out to take what the event implies.

code.description: The regulation cited, such as 393.47(e).

description.description: What was cited, as the inspection report words it.

outOfService.description: Whether this violation put the driver or vehicle out of service.

safetyEventId.description: The safety event, from worker_list_safety_events. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Adds a cited violation to a safety event inside Trenova; nothing is sent, and it is corrected or removed the same way.

tools.name: worker_record_training_completion
tools.description: Record that a worker finished a training course. Give the open assignment's id, or the worker and course directly for a classroom session recorded after the fact. A scored course needs the score and fails below its passing mark; a pass sets when a recurring course next expires.

completedAt.description: The day it was finished. Defaults to today; never a day to come. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

courseId.description: The course, from worker_list_training_courses, with workerId when there is no trainingId. Beside trainingId it must be that assignment's course.

documentId.description: A document already filed on the worker, from document_list. Never guess one.

note.description: Anything the record should say.

score.description: The score, such as 92, for a scored course.

trainingRecordId.description: The training assignment, from worker_list_training. Never guess one.

workerId.description: The driver, from worker_list. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Records a completion on the worker's training record inside Trenova; nothing is sent, and a completion recorded in error is corrected by a person.

tools.name: worker_reject_pto
tools.description: Decline a worker's time-off request. A rejection is final — the request cannot be reopened, and the worker is told why — so the reason must be the one you were actually given, not one you composed.

ptoId.description: The id of the time-off request, from worker_list_time_off. A worker id is not a request id.

reason.description: Why it is being declined. Required, and shown to the worker. If nobody told you why, ask rather than guessing.

policy.rationale: The worker is sent the rejection reason by push notice and text message.

tools.name: worker_reject_shift_swap
tools.description: Reject a shift swap, with the reason the workers read, when the office cannot let the day change hands.

note.description: What the workers are told about it.

swapId.description: The swap, from worker_get_schedule. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Refuses a request the workers read in their portal; a person approves each refusal.

tools.name: worker_request_credential_renewal
tools.description: Ask a driver to renew the papers that are coming due, in one message covering every credential rather than one per certificate. Name each credential and its expiry date. This only asks; it does not record a renewal or change what is on file.

credentialIds.description: Every credential this ask covers, by the id worker_list_credentials or worker_get_credential returns, or the one the event that started this run names. Never invent one.

note.description: What the driver is being asked for, in their words: which papers, by when, and where to send them.

workerId.description: The driver whose papers are due, from worker_get.

policy.rationale: Sends a driver a renewal request the model wrote.

tools.name: worker_request_leave_certification
tools.description: Record that medical certification was asked for on a leave case and start its clock. It is due in the organization's certification window, fifteen days by default, or on the day given. Asking the worker is done by the person; this keeps the date.

dueDate.description: When it is due, when not the usual window. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

leaveCaseId.description: The leave case, from worker_list_leave_cases. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Starts the certification clock on a leave case inside Trenova; nothing is sent to the worker, and a later request restarts it.

tools.name: worker_request_pto
tools.description: File a time-off request for a worker who asked for it, over the days given. It counts the days against their policy and refuses days that overlap time off already booked, a blackout, or more than the balance allows. Under a policy that needs no approval it is approved and booked at once and the driver is told; otherwise it waits for worker_approve_pto.

endDate.description: The last day off. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

reason.description: The reason the worker gave, when one was given; the driver sees it with the request. Omit it rather than ask, and the kind is used.

startDate.description: The first day off. "Next Friday" is the coming Friday, not the one a week later. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

workerId.description: The driver, from worker_list. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Files time off the driver sees in Dash; under a policy with no approval step it is booked and the driver told at once, and worker_cancel_pto withdraws it.

tools.name: worker_request_shift_swap
tools.description: Raise a shift swap for a worker who asked the office: they give up a day, handed to another worker or traded for one of theirs. It waits for the other worker to accept and the office to approve.

counterpartyShiftDate.description: The day offered back, when it is a trade rather than a hand-off. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

counterpartyWorkerId.description: The worker asked to take it, from worker_list. Leave out to offer it to anyone.

reason.description: Why, in the worker's words where you have them.

requestingWorkerId.description: The worker giving the day up, from worker_list. Never guess one.

shiftDate.description: The day given up. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

policy.rationale: Opens a request inside Trenova that changes nobody's schedule until it is approved; worker_withdraw_shift_swap takes it back.

tools.name: worker_run_dot_random_draw
tools.description: Draw a random testing round from a pool for the period a day falls in, today by default. The pool's rates set how many drivers each substance needs; the names are chosen only when the round is drawn, under a seed nobody sees first, so the preview names no one. The round starts as a draft a person reviews and finalizes with worker_finalize_dot_random_draw, or cancels.

drawDate.description: A day inside the period to draw for, for a period that was missed. Defaults to today. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

note.description: Anything the round's record should say.

poolId.description: The pool, from worker_list_dot_random_draws. Leave it out to draw from the organization's default pool.

policy.rationale: Draws a draft round inside Trenova; nobody is told and nothing is final until a person finalizes it, and worker_cancel_dot_random_draw withdraws it.

tools.name: worker_schedule_dot_test
tools.description: Schedule a drug or alcohol test for a driver. It covers a random selection's collection, a post-accident or reasonable-suspicion test, pre-employment, return-to-duty or follow-up. A collection covering both substances is two calls. It records the order only; results are entered by the person who receives them from the lab or the medical review officer.

drawEntryId.description: For a random test: the selection it answers, from worker_get_dot_random_draw.

isDot.description: Whether it is a DOT-regulated test. Defaults to true; a company-policy test is false.

note.description: Anything the collector should know.

reason.description: What prompted it. Required for a post-accident or reasonable-suspicion test; write what was observed or what happened.

safetyEventId.description: For a post-accident test: the accident, from worker_list_safety_events.

scheduledAt.description: When the collection is booked. A date and time with its UTC offset (RFC 3339), such as 2026-10-01T08:00:00-05:00.

workerId.description: The driver, from worker_list. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Files a scheduled collection inside Trenova. The driver is sent nothing, no result is recorded, and worker_cancel_dot_test withdraws it.

tools.name: worker_send_message
tools.description: Send a driver a message in the Dash app, such as a moved pickup, a new delivery window, a weather warning on their route, or a request to call dispatch. Passing on what the person told you needs no record checked or changed first: send it as they said it, naming the load when you know it. Keep it to what the driver needs to do; it goes to their phone. A driver without portal access cannot be reached this way, and the message is not delivered; say so if a reply matters. It is a message, not a record: put anything the office needs later on the shipment with shipment_add_comment.

message.description: The message, at most 500 characters, in plain words.

priority.description: How urgently the phone should show it. Default medium.

shipmentId.description: Optional: the shipment the message is about, so Dash can open it; from dispatch_get_board, shipment_get_tracking or shipment_list.

title.description: A short subject line, such as "Delivery moved to 3 PM".

workerId.description: The driver's id, from the board, tracking or worker_list.

policy.rationale: Sends a driver a message the model wrote to their phone.

tools.name: worker_set_availability_preference
tools.description: Record whether a worker prefers, is available for or cannot work one weekday, as they told the office. The rota shows it beside their pattern; it does not change the pattern.

note.description: Why, in the worker's words where you have them.

preference.description: What the worker said about that day.

workerId.description: The driver, from worker_list. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Records a worker's own stated preference inside Trenova; nothing is sent, and it is set again the same way.

tools.name: worker_set_safety_event_status
tools.description: Move a safety event to under review, closed or back to open. Review marks it under review while it is looked into, Close resolves it with the resolution kept on the record, and Reopen puts a closed or reviewed event back on the open list.

resolution.description: For Close: how it was resolved. Required to close; say what was actually done, not what you composed.

safetyEventId.description: The safety event, from worker_list_safety_events. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Moves a safety event's status inside Trenova; nothing is sent, and the event is reopened or closed again the same way.

tools.name: worker_start_checklist
tools.description: Start a checklist for a worker from one of the organization's hand-started templates, such as an annual file audit. Onboarding and offboarding checklists start from the hire or the termination and are refused here. A template already open for the worker is not started twice.

startedAt.description: The day it starts, which its items fall due from. Defaults to today. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

templateId.description: The template, from worker_list_checklists. Never guess one.

workerId.description: The driver, from worker_list. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Opens a checklist on the worker inside Trenova; nothing is sent, and worker_cancel_checklist cancels it.

tools.name: worker_start_performance_review
tools.description: Open a draft performance review for a worker from a review template. It covers a period, with the person who approves it as the reviewer. The template's items are copied on unrated; worker_update_performance_review fills them in. The worker sees nothing until the reviewer submits it.

periodEnd.description: The last day the review covers. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

periodStart.description: The first day the review covers. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

templateId.description: The review template, from worker_list_performance_reviews. Never guess one.

title.description: A title; defaults to the template and period.

workerId.description: The driver, from worker_list. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Opens a draft review inside Trenova; the worker sees nothing, and worker_delete_performance_review removes the draft.

tools.name: worker_update_checklist_item
tools.description: Settle or reopen one item on a worker's open checklist. Complete it when it is done, with a document as evidence when there is one; Skip or NotApplicable with a note saying why; or Reopen a settled item. A checklist whose required items are all settled closes on its own.

checklistItemId.description: The item, from worker_list_checklists. Never guess one.

evidenceDocumentId.description: For Complete: a document filed on the worker that shows it done, from document_list.

note.description: What was done, or why it was skipped or does not apply. Required to skip or mark not applicable.

policy.rationale: Settles or reopens a checklist item inside Trenova; nothing is sent, and a settled item is reopened the same way.

tools.name: worker_update_credential
tools.description: Correct a credential on file: its number, issuer, dates, document or notes. Give only what changes. Changing a fact a person verified clears the verification. An archived credential is read-only; record a new one instead.

credentialId.description: The credential, from worker_list_credentials. Never guess one.

documentId.description: A document already filed on the worker, from document_list. Never guess one.

expiresAt.description: When it expires. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

issuedAt.description: When it was issued. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

issuingAuthority.description: Who issued it, such as the state.

note.description: Anything the credential should say.

number.description: The number on the card or certificate, exactly as printed.

policy.rationale: Corrects a credential inside Trenova, which can change whether the worker may be dispatched; nothing is sent, and it is corrected again the same way.

tools.name: worker_update_dot_random_selection
tools.description: Record where one random testing selection stands. Notified once the driver has been told to report, Excused with the reason when they cannot be tested this period, or Missed. A selection completes on its own when its test is recorded.

drawEntryId.description: The selection, from worker_get_dot_random_draw. Never guess one.

excuseReason.description: For Excused: why, such as extended leave.

status.description: Notified, Excused or Missed.

policy.rationale: Updates a selection on a round inside Trenova; nothing is sent to the driver, and the selection is updated again the same way.

tools.name: worker_update_employment_verification
tools.description: Correct a previous employer on the qualification file, or record their answer. The answer is when it came back, the accidents and drug and alcohol violations it reports, the findings and the document. Give only what changes, from the answer itself.

contactEmail.description: Their email address, as the application gives it.

contactPhone.description: Their phone number, as the application gives it.

documentId.description: A document already filed on the worker, from document_list. Never guess one.

drugAlcoholResponseReceivedAt.description: When their drug and alcohol answer came back. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

employedFrom.description: When the worker started there. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

employedTo.description: When the worker left. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

findings.description: What the employer's answer says, from the document they sent.

hadDrugAlcoholViolations.description: Whether they reported a drug or alcohol violation.

note.description: Anything the file should say.

responseReceivedAt.description: When the employer's answer came back. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

status.description: Where the request stands.

verificationId.description: The previous employer's verification, from worker_list_employment_verifications. Never guess one.

wasDotRegulated.description: Whether the job was DOT-regulated, which brings the drug and alcohol questions in.

policy.rationale: Updates the previous employer's record in the qualification file inside Trenova; nothing is sent, and it is corrected again the same way.

tools.name: worker_update_injury
tools.description: Correct or bring up to date an injury case: its classification, treatment, days away or restricted, return to work, the claim, or close it. Give only what changes. The log must stay accurate for five years after its year, so a closed case is still corrected.

bodyPart.description: The part of the body affected.

claimClosedAt.description: When the claim closed. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

claimFiledAt.description: When the claim was filed. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

claimStatus.description: Where the workers' comp claim stands.

classification.description: How the case is classified on the OSHA 300 log. Recordability is the employer's judgement: leave it out unless a person gave it, and the case takes the classification the treatment suggests.

daysAway.description: Days away from work, capped at 180 as the log counts them.

daysRestricted.description: Days on restricted duty or job transfer.

description.description: What happened and the injury.

documentId.description: A document already filed on the worker, from document_list. Never guess one.

harmfulAgent.description: What harmed the worker, such as a load strap.

illnessType.description: Injury, or the kind of illness.

injuryId.description: The injury case, from worker_list_injuries. Never guess one.

note.description: Anything the case should say.

occurredAt.description: When it happened. A date and time with its UTC offset (RFC 3339), such as 2026-10-01T08:00:00-05:00.

privacyCase.description: Whether the worker's name is withheld from the log as a privacy case.

reportedAt.description: When the worker reported it. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

returnedToWorkAt.description: When the worker came back to work. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

safetyEventId.description: The accident it came from, from worker_list_safety_events.

status.description: Open or Closed.

policy.rationale: Corrects a case on the OSHA log inside Trenova; nothing is sent, and it is corrected again the same way.

tools.name: worker_update_leave_case
tools.description: Correct or fill in a leave case as it goes: the kind, how it is taken, the dates, hours worked for eligibility, a document, notes. Give only what changes. It never decides the case.

documentId.description: A document already filed on the worker, from document_list. Never guess one.

eligibilityHoursWorked.description: Hours worked in the twelve months before, for eligibility.

endsAt.description: The last day of leave, when it is known. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

leaveCaseId.description: The leave case, from worker_list_leave_cases. Never guess one.

militaryCaregiver.description: Whether it is leave to care for a covered servicemember.

note.description: Anything the case should say.

reason.description: Why, as the worker gave it. Keep medical detail out; the certification carries that.

startsAt.description: The first day of leave. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

policy.rationale: Corrects a leave case inside Trenova; nothing is decided or sent, and it is corrected again the same way.

tools.name: worker_update_leave_day
tools.description: Correct a day of leave already recorded: the hours, whether it counts against the entitlement, the time off it runs with, or its note. Give only what changes.

countsAgainstEntitlement.description: Whether this day counts against the FMLA entitlement.

hours.description: Hours taken that day, such as 8 or 4.5.

leaveDayId.description: The day of leave, from worker_list_leave_cases. Never guess one.

note.description: The day's note.

ptoId.description: Paid time off booked for the same day, from worker_list_time_off.

policy.rationale: Corrects a recorded day of leave inside Trenova; nothing is sent, and it is corrected again the same way.

tools.name: worker_update_performance_review
tools.description: Fill in a draft performance review: score its items 1 to 5 with a comment each, and write the summary, strengths, improvements and goals. Only a draft is edited, and only what you give changes. Draw every score from the record, such as the safety scorecard and training, and say so in the comment; the reviewer submits it, not you.

goals.description: The goals for the next period. Given, they replace the review's goals; left out, the goals stay.

dueAt.description: When it is due. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

status.description: Open, Done or Dropped. Defaults to Open.

ratings.description: Scores for the review's items, each by the key worker_list_performance_reviews shows. Items left out keep what they have.

comment.description: Why that score, from the record.

reviewId.description: The review, from worker_list_performance_reviews. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Saves the reviewer's draft inside Trenova; the worker sees nothing until the reviewer submits it, and the draft is edited again the same way.

tools.name: worker_update_pto
tools.description: Change the kind, days or reason of a time-off request still waiting for a decision. Give only what changes. A decided request is refused; cancel it and file another.

endDate.description: The last day off. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

ptoId.description: The id of the time-off request, from worker_list_time_off. A worker id is not a request id.

reason.description: The reason the worker gave, when one was given; the driver sees it with the request. Omit it rather than ask, and the kind is used.

startDate.description: The first day off. "Next Friday" is the coming Friday, not the one a week later. A calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-01.

policy.rationale: Changes a pending request the driver sees in Dash; it is changed again the same way.

tools.name: worker_update_safety_event
tools.description: Correct a safety event on a driver's record: what happened, when, the points it carries, the inspection result, the fine or cost. Give only what changes. It never moves the event's status; worker_set_safety_event_status does.

costAmount.description: What it cost the company, as a decimal such as 1800.00.

description.description: What happened, in the words of the report or the person who told you.

documentId.description: A document already filed on the worker, from document_list. Never guess one.

fineAmount.description: A fine, as a decimal such as 250.00.

inspectionLevel.description: For an inspection: its CVSA level.

inspectionResult.description: For an inspection: how it ended.

occurredAt.description: When it happened. A date and time with its UTC offset (RFC 3339), such as 2026-10-01T08:00:00-05:00.

outOfService.description: Whether the driver or the vehicle was put out of service.

points.description: The points it carries on the driver's record. Leave it out on a new event to take the house scale for the kind and severity.

preventable.description: For an accident: whether it was preventable. Leave it out unless the report says so.

referenceNumber.description: A citation, report or inspection number.

resolution.description: How it was resolved, kept on the event.

safetyEventId.description: The safety event, from worker_list_safety_events. Never guess one.

shipmentId.description: The load it happened on, from shipment_list or shipment_get. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Corrects an event on a driver's safety record inside Trenova; nothing is sent, and the event is corrected again the same way.

tools.name: worker_update_safety_violation
tools.description: Correct a roadside violation cited on a safety event: its BASIC, regulation, wording, severity weight or out-of-service flag. Give only what changes.

basic.description: The BASIC it falls under. Leave it out to take what the event implies.

code.description: The regulation cited, such as 393.47(e).

description.description: What was cited, as the inspection report words it.

outOfService.description: Whether this violation put the driver or vehicle out of service.

violationId.description: The violation, from worker_list_safety_events. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Corrects a cited violation inside Trenova; nothing is sent, and it is corrected again the same way.

tools.name: worker_withdraw_shift_swap
tools.description: Withdraw a shift swap on the proposing worker's behalf, when they told the office they no longer want it.

note.description: What the workers are told about it.

swapId.description: The swap, from worker_get_schedule. Never guess one.

policy.rationale: Takes back a request the workers read in their portal; a person approves each withdrawal.
